[cykette] With Secret of Mana being my favorite game of all time, I'm kinda ashamed that I've never finished FFA. Time to rectify that! I'll definitely be playing and mastering this game soon.

[StonySnowflake] cykette: I'm playing it now to see how it differs, but if you liked Secret, Sword is DEFINITELY better to play than this if there's no nostalgia.

Sword of Mana is a remake of Seiken Densetsu 1 (we have as FF Adventure). Then Secret, then SD3/Trials. You can play the Trails remake for mid gen, it's honestly a little better save nostalgia than the SNES, and has a NG+.

I will say Trials remake has extra content based on a character from Dawn of Mana (PS2). It's a nice game with cute story, and I wish they'd make chevos for it soon.

If you haven't checked out Legend, def check it out ASAP: It's my favorite. Most robust crafting system of any game I've played to date. 3 branching storylines you can follow to get to the end of the game, and they're still finding hidden convos this long after.

source_title: Final Fantasy Adventure — RetroAchievements community comments
text:
[OmniMirror] Mastery #259: I played this one very briefly as a kid, and when I saw this got achievements, I had to revisit it.  This was quite an ambitious title and ended up being a fair bit longer than I thought!  Thank you for the set!  I also second the comment about it being a good thing that this game did not have any no-hit achievements, as I did notice a lot of phantom hits especially with certain weapons.

[Roufuss] Loved it as a kid, some parts have aged a little for the worse (the constant weapon swapping..) but I still loved it now.

Mastery 85, overall a very easy and breezy set but it works for this game. Really glad to not see any damageless for the reasons mentioned above.

A lot of good comments in the cheevos too, especially for farming armor!

[Bralef] Great game! Thoroughly enjoyed it, despite running out of keys 90% of the way through an annoying dungeon. As for the achievements, my only complaint is that "Robots Can't Jump" triggering before its respective cutscene kinda spoils the moment. I would have had it trigger after the cutscene is over, personally, or give it a different name.

[Harlaown] +1 on supporting the DX Patch

[CardsharkKiri] Mastery #1

A fairly simple but entertaining game and a long time favorite with or without the Mana series connections.  The music is really the highlight for me, and having this with my GB got me through many a move in the past, so I was very glad to see the set here!

[MarceloAGDB] This set is good.  I wouldn't be against bosses without damage but even with an amazing power stat or wisdom stat some of these bosses take a good chunk and have bullshit patterns. the only good thing is that you can save before any boss for retries. Other than that, the set is fair and fun, although I must add that if you dont "waste stats" in a balanced manner, good luck getting the 50 stat points later down the line. I had to new game for wisdom because I did a full power and by the end levelling was taking forever to raise anything. If you stop at a stat on their 50s and go for another, it might work? dunno.

[almostasandwich] Mastery #6

One of my favourite Game Boy games from my childhood. This was quite an easy mastery, especially due to my familiarity with the over world and dungeons. I found the points to be very generous. Towards the very end of the game the 10 and 25 point achievements were popping off like crazy. I think this game stands side-by-side with other great GB classics like Zelda: Link's Awakening and the OG Pokemon games. It's a shame it's so overlooked but it did go on to spawn one of my favourite Super Nintendo games, Secret of Mana. I think calling this game Final Fantasy Adventure is a bit of a misnomer, despite it sharing some elements with it's namesake. Anyway, i'm very happy to get this mastery and thanks very much to the set creator as it was short but very, very sweet! (As others have mentioned I'm very grateful there's no damageless on the bosses). I might give the Embers of Mana Hack a go next. Would be interested to hear from anyone who's tried it.

[max214013] +1 on supporting the DX Patch, please!

[Monkeyboy34] @max214013
Actually the DX patch is supported and you can play in color. I finished the compatibility test for it and it was added to the supported hashes a few days ago.

Also, for the record everyone, if you want a patch supported (colorization, translation, qol, etc.), do a compatibility test and put the effort in yourself, don’t just ask other people to do it for you.

[Zooperdoop] This was my second mastery, but more importantly, my first Mana game. It's honestly just a really solid game after so many years. For the most part, your typical JRPG story, but it hits all the right notes and I still had a couple emotional moments with it.

Of course a few mechanics haven't dated well, but once you get adjusted to all the inventory swapping, it's mostly fine. I would recommend looking up a world map while travelling overworld, I think two hours of my play time was wasted on trying to find certain points once I could start traveling over water.

Very much looking forward to Secrets of Mana.

[blueberryteal] mastery #11! somehow the first Mana game i've actually finished even tho i've played a TON of Trials and Legend. maybe now i'm actually gonna play em all proper iunno!!

i'm kinda stuck between feeling this game was too short or just the right length; it doesn't overstay its welcome but i feel the mechanics could be more fleshed out, and the story could've been more than randomly inserted dramatic moments. still, solid first game

stock up on at least a couple stacks of Keys and Mattocks before dungeons, then you won't have to worry about getting stuck like the first time i tried this game years ago. once you get the Morning Star you don't need Mattocks period

the missable achievements arent too bad if you know which dungeons to watch out for, thanks to people in the comments under achievements for that. also if you ever need to grind (for leveling or loot), leave one enemy alive on a screen so that enemies can instantly respawn when you switch screens

text:
============================================================
ACHIEVEMENT 29091 - Samurai Style
============================================================
Description: Equip the best armor and helm

[Baobabastass] The armor is drop by the Ninja and the helmet by the Demon Head (their forms is similar to their names) in the last dungeon. For the tip, when an ennemy loots a chest, if your inventory is full, examine the chest until gain the armor and the helmet.

[Server] televandalist edited this achievement.

[Server] Suffa28 edited this achievement.

[BruceLee1255] The RNG HATES ME.

[Server] VampireLord edited this achievement's title, description.

[StonySnowflake] THANK YOU BOA! This advice may single-handedly be the biggest timesaving comment of any I've seen on this site so far.

I would like to add that you can respawn the room until there's 2 enemies. Then leave and come back when you kill one, and it resets.

I got this in a couple minutes with this and resetting the game when I killed them.

[Bucket0fLunch] Isn't this missable? Sure sounds missable.

[SpectralOrion] Got a pretty good solution that got me both pieces of armor rather quickly. Rather than going back and forth between rooms, you can camp in one room.

1. Go to a room with ninjas. Kill them. Save. Soft reset the game, load, and a new set of ninjas will spawn. You can farm EXP and Elixirs while you're looking for Samurai Armor.

2. Go to a room with the demon heads (likely the very first room of the Temple of Mana). Do the same exact thing to get the Samurai Helm, except kill the demons with the Nuke spell. Save and use up whatever Ethers and Elixirs on hand to get your MP back. And of course, leveling up will help too.

Got both in less than 30 minutes.

[randresen77] It works better if you just leave one enemy alive and go back out and come back in. YOu dont have to soft reset.  It took me about 20 minutes to farm both towards the end of the dungeon.

[Baobabastass] The shield is drop by monster who likes elephant, just before the final boss. For the tip, when an ennemy loots a chest, if your inventory is full, examine the chest until gain the shield.

[Server] televandalist edited this achievement.

[Server] VampireLord edited this achievement's title, description.

[StonySnowflake] To add to Boa's wonderful advice: You can reload the screen until 2 elephants are on by leaving and coming back without killing.

Do this for each of the 2 or 3 screens they show on. Kill them, get any boxes. By this point, you're probably low on items. These drop Unicorns, an item you can use to fill a slot.

Keep killing the screens with them, saving and resetting. You'll end up with a full inventory. If you haven't gotten the shield by then, you can use his trick at this point.

[randresen77] Took me about 5 minutes to farm this.  just leave one alive exit and re enter the screen.

section: II. Tutorial and Guide to FFA
text:
=======================================================================
II. Tutorial and Guide to FFA
=======================================================================

-> The order and information of this tutorial is based upon the
instruction manual of Final Fantasy Adventure

---------
Storyline
---------

The world of Final Fantasy Adventure is infused with the power of the
Mana Tree, the source of all life in this world. The Tree of Mana is
guarded by the Gemma Knights, who defend it against the evils of the
Glaive Empire. Now the empire of Glaive, head by Dark Lord and his
servant the sorcerer Julius. Our Hero, a warrior of great renown,
sneaked into Glaive Castle in hopes of discovering their evil plans.
Captured by the sorcerer Julius, and to do this, he must fight every
day. One day after fighting the Hero comes the Hero was enslaved and
brought to the Arena. Here he must fight to survive back and finds his
dear friend Willy dying. Willy tells the Hero, "Mana is in Danger
now... We must let the knights of Gemma know about it." As Willy passes
away, the Hero swears vengeance and his quest begins.


Tree of Mana grows with the energy of
will from each and every thing of this world.

It grows high above the clouds in the air
on top of Mount Illusia.

Legend tells that it gives eternal power
to the one who touched it.

Dark Lord was trying to find the way to
the Tree of Mana and get the mighty
power to conquer the world.

==================
 GameBoy Controls
==================

Directional Pad

section: The directional pad allows you to move your character on the screen.
text:
---------------
The directional pad allows you to move your character on the screen.
Your character can be moved in only four directions, up, down, left,
and right, but not diagonal. The directional pad can also move the
cursor on the menu screen.

A Button
--------
- On the World Screen, the A button can be used to make your character
attack with the weapon he has equipped.
- On the Menu Screen, the A button is used to execute the command that
you have selected. Attack with weapon and select a command on the menu
screen.

B Button
---------
- On the World Screen, the B button can be used to use Magic or an Item
that you are equipped with.
- On the Menu Screen, the B button can be used to cancel a command that
has been selected or to exit a menu screen.

Start
-----
The Start button opens the screen for Item/Magic/Equip/Ask commands,
the weapon and magic your character is currently equipped with, and
your character's condition.

Select
------
The Select button opens the screen for Save/Map/Status commands.

==============
 Menu Screens
==============
-----------------------------
Menu Screen- 1 (World Screen)
-----------------------------
 _________________     __________________________________
|   -KEY-         |   |MMMMMMMMMMMMMMM V MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM|
|                 |   |MMMMMMMMMMMMMMM V MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM|

| B= Bushes       |   |                                  |
| M= Mountains    |   |                                  |
| HP= Hit Points  |   |~~~~~~~|-|~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~|
| MP= Magic Points|   |~~~~~~~|-|~~~~~RIVER~~~~~~~~~~~~~~|
| G= Gold         |   |~~~~~~~|-|~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~|

                      |BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB|
                      |----------------------------------|
                      | HP    31    MP    10     G     50|

| (==============================) |
                       ----------------------------------

Current HP- The HP value shown on the bottom left of the screen shows
how much HP you currently have. Once this value drops to zero you will
die.

Current MP- The MP value shown on the bottom middle of the screen shows
how much MP you currently have. Once this value drops to zero you will
not be able to cast any more spells.

Current Gold- This value shown on the bottom right of the screen shows
how much Gold you currently possess. Gold is the monetary standard in
Final Fantasy Adventure.

Attack Gauge- This gauge measures your attack power. Once the gauge is
full you can use your MAX Attack.

-------------------------------------
Menu Screen- 2 (Item/Magic/Equip/ASK)
-------------------------------------

-> Press Start to open this screen.

section: G A M E B O Y - S C R E E N

             |   +-----------------------------+   |
             |                                     |
             +-------------------------------------+

Commands- (ITEM/MAGIC/EQUIP/ASK)- The commands are located near the top
left corner of the screen. Use the directional pad to move the cursor
to the different commands.

Status- This box displays your condition: Good, Poison, Moogle, Stone,
or Darkness.

Magic/Item & Weapon- This box displays the Item or Magic you have
equipped and the current weapon that you have equipped. To use the
Magic or Item that you have equipped, press the B button. To use your
weapon, press the A button.

------------
Sub-Commands
------------

- Item Sub-Menu -
-----------------
  _____________________
 | Item 1     Item 2   |
 | Item 3     Item 4   |
 | Item 5     Item 6   |
 | Item 7     Item 8   |
 | Item 9     Item 10  |
 | Item 11    Item 12  |
 | Item 13    Item 14  |
 | Item 15    Item 16  |
 |               TRASH |
 +---------------------+

-There are only 16 Items slots.

Using an Item:
You can move the cursor to different items my moving the directional
pad. To select the item of your choice, press the A button twice. To
use the item, press the B button once.

Changing an Item:
Move the cursor to the item that you want to move. Press the A button
once, and then a second cursor will appear. Move this cursor to the
spot where you wish to move you item. Then press the A button and the
item will move. You can also use this process to exchange different
items on the item screen.

Discarding an Item:
To discard an item, move the cursor to the item that you want to
discard. Press the A button once, and then a second cursor will appear.
Move this cursor to the Trash Can and press the A button. The item will
now disappear from the screen.
*NOTE* Once an item has been placed in the Trash Can, you will not be
able to get it back from the Trash Can.

- Magic Sub-Menu -
------------------
    _____________
   | Cure   Fire |
   | Slep   Heal |
   | Ice    Mute |
   | Lit    Nuke |
   +-------------+

-There are only eight magic spells in the game.
-This screen will display every magic spell that you currently have.

Using Magic:
To use Magic, move the cursor to the desired magic spell. Now press the
A button once. This will equip your magic. To cast your magic spell,
press the B button. However, if you do not have sufficient MP to use
the spell, the magic will not be cast.

Removing Magic:
Since magic spells use MP, it is recommended that once you are finished
using your magic that you put it back. This is because you do not want
to waster MP's accidentally by casting a spell. To remove the magic
spell that you are equipped with, you should exchange the magic with
any item that cannot be operated accidentally by pressing the B button.

- Equipment Sub-Menu -
----------------------

+---------------------+
| Weapon      Helmet  |
| AP   66     Armor   |
| DP   78     Shield  |
+---------------------+
| Eq 1        Eq 2    |
| Eq 3        Eq 4    |
| Eq 5        Eq 6    |
| Eq 7        Eq 8    |
| Eq 9        Eq 10   |
| Eq 11       Eq 12   |
|               Trash |
+---------------------+

Weapon- The Weapon that you currently have.
Helmet- The Helmet that you currently have equipped.
Armor- The Armor that you currently have equipped.
Shield- The Shield that you currently have equipped.
AP- Characters current attack power.
DP- Characters current defense power.

Changing Weapons/Armor:
Move the cursor to the weapon that you want to move. Press the A button
twice. The weapon that you selected has now replaced the weapon that
you were equipped with. You should also note that your AP value should
have changed. (You can change armor using the same procedure, just
replace the word weapon with armor, and AP with DP)

Discarding Weapons/Armor:
You can discard some of your weapons, but there are some weapons that
you are unable to get rid of. This helps to prevent people from selling
specific weapons, or types of weapons with which they need to complete
the game. To discard a weapon, move the cursor to the weapon that you
want to discard. Press the A button once, and then a second cursor will
appear. Move this cursor to the Trash Can and press the A button. The
weapon will now disappear from the screen.
*NOTE* Once a weapon has been placed in the Trash Can, you will not be
able to get it back from the Trash Can. (You can use the same procedure
to discard armor, just replace the word weapon with armor)

-Ask Command -
---------------

This command will let you ASK a NPC, if one is currently in your group
for help. NPC's can help you in various and important ways, so always
check to see what your NPC says or can do for you.

--------------------------------
Menu Screen- 3 (Save/Map/Status)
--------------------------------

-> Press Select to open this screen.
-> To access any of these sub-menus move the cursor and press the A
button.

+---------------------------+
| Save      Map      Status |
+---------------------------+

- Save Sub-Menu -
-----------------

To save a game, press the Select button, to bring up the previous menu
screen. Make sure that the cursor is positioned on Save, and press the
A button. The save sub-menu screen should now appear.

-> You have 2 different possible records with which you can save your
game.

   +-------------------+
   | Name  HP  77/  77 |
   |       MP  21/  21 |
   | L 11  E      1411 |
   |         /    1516 |
   +-------------------+
   +-------------------+
   | Name  HP 999/ 999 |
   |       MP  99/  99 |
   | L 98  E   1200000 |
   |         / 1201982 |
   +-------------------+

Name- The name of your character will appear here.
HP- The current / maximum amount of HP will be listed here.
MP The current / maximum amount of MP will be listed here.
L- The level of your character will be listed here.
E- Your current amount of experience will be listed on top / the amount
of experience that your character needs to advance to the next level.

- Map Sub-Menu -
----------------

The map sub-menu is very important, but many game players fail to
utilize this tool. The Map will show the world screen, towns, caves and
castles. The general map that is called up when you are NOT in a
dungeon is very general, only showing giving you a very broad idea of
the world. When in a dungeon, the rooms displayed will be those of the
dungeon only. Each time you enter a new room, the cave map will be
updated with the new information. The dungeon maps are much more
intricate. Dungeon maps will show you the entrances to different rooms.

-> One grid on the map will always represent one screen.

|           |   |              |

+------------------------------+

- You can see the different entrances to individual rooms.
- Only the rooms that have been explored are displayed.

Wisdom - The amount of Wisdom your character has.

===============
 Game Tutorial
===============
----------------------------
Saving and Loading your Game
----------------------------

Saving:
The game Final Fantasy Adventure has 2 Slots. You can only save 1 Game
for every slot. This means that you can either have two different games
saved, or have save the same game saved in two different slots.

Loading:
You can only load a game by accessing the continue option during the
main menu.

Resting/Turning Off:
To reset the game you must press the A, B, Select, and Start buttons at
the same time. To access the games main menu you may also turn the
GameBoy off, and then back on. However, when you do either of these
methods, your game will not be saved.

Moving your character
---------------------

You move your character around with the directional pad. By pressing
left on the directional pad your character will move left. The same
applies with pressing the control pad in other directions, right=right,
up=up and down=down.

In the world screen, you'll also see some towns with people in it. You
can talk to these people, or simply avoid them. For the most part,
talking to people is not really important, but it does make the game-
play more interesting in my opinion.

Some terrain your character will be able to move over, but some he will
not. By using weapons, your character can cut or smash terrain that
blocks your path. Here is a list of terrain that allows travel, doesn't
allow travel, and terrain that can be cut or smashed.

Geography of the World of Final Fantasy Adventure:

section: Terrain that your character can travel over
text:
Terrain that your character can travel over
   -------------------------------------------
   Meadows - A region covered with low grass
   Marshes - An area with long damp grass
   Deserts - Stretches of golden sand
   Vines - Located on mountain walls
   Snowfields - A region covered with snow
   Desert of Crystal - A region with sharp crystals
   Field of Floating Rocks - A region with large floating rocks
   Bridges - Log bridges that cross over rivers

   Terrain that your character CANNOT travel over
   ----------------------------------------------
   *Forests - A region covered with trees
   Bushes - A region covered with large leafy plants
   Rock-Walls - The walls of mountains
   Oasis's - Fountains of water found in the desert
   Oceans - Large bodies of water around different continents
   Rivers - Small stretches of water crossing the land
   Lakes - Small bodies of water surrounded by land

section: Terrain that can be cut or broken to allow travel
text:
Terrain that can be cut or broken to allow travel
   -------------------------------------------------
   Forests - Trees that can be cut by an Axe.
   Marshes - Vines that can be cut by Sickles
   Floating Rocks - Rocks that can be smashed by the Morning Star


Geography of Dungeons:

   Stairs/Doors/Damage
   -------------------
   Ascending - Stairs that allow you to move up a floor
   Descending - Stairs that allow you to move down a floor
   Door - Can be opened by walking through, but some need Keys.
   Spikes/Lave/Barriers - When touched deal damage to Hero.

   Terrain that can be cut or broken to allow travel
   -------------------------------------------------
   Ferns - Can be cut with a Sickle
   Thorns - Can be cut with an Axe
   Rocks - Can be smashed with a Mattock or Morning Star
   Pots - Can be smashed with a Mattock or Morning Star

-------------
Battle System
-------------

Attacking
---------

Weapons:
The weapon attack is the most basic kind of attack. To attack enemies,
move your character so that the enemy is in range of your weapon. Then
press the A button. Every time you successfully hit the enemy he will
receive damage. Once his HP's reach 0, he will die.

Magic:
There are six types of magic that can be used for attacking. To use
magic on an enemy you must have the magic equipped. Then, press the B
button. Some types of magic only fly in straight lines, while others
will require you to manipulate the magic using the Directional Pad.

Items:
There are eight different types of Items that can be used for attacking
the enemy. Item attacks are used the same way as magic attacks and have
the same general effect as a magic spell would. However, the damage
dealt might be different, and unlike magic, Items have a limited number
of uses.

Defending
---------
When walking on the world screen or in dungeons, you will encounter
monsters. If you touch a monster, you will receive damage at once. The
only way to prevent damage is to either to avoid the monster, or touch
him with your Shield. Your Shield will only work if it is equipped, you
have the appropriate type of shield, and your level is higher than that
monster. If you have met all these requirements, you can push the
monster from your path using the shield.

------------------
Weapon Will Powers
------------------

When you are equipped with a weapon, your Will Meter (found at the
bottom of the screen), will increase until it is at its maximum. When
it reaches its max, your weapon will attack in a unique way. The same
weapon types will have the same unique attack. (i.e., the Broad Sword
and the dragon sword do the same thing) The different types of weapons
below are listed in the order that they are found in and with a
description of what the weapon will do.

Type-          DESCRIPTION (MAX)
----------------------------------------------------------------
Swords         Spin Attack - Press and hold the A button. This will
               make your character spin with his sword. While
               spinning you can move him with the directional pad.

               Charge Attack - Press the A Button and the Directional
               pad. Your character will charge in the direction you
               pushed the Directional pad in.

Axes           It will be thrown in the direction you're facing.

Sickle         The Sickle will extend longer than normal

Chains         The Chain will extend longer than normal

Spears         The Spear will be thrown in the direction you're facing.

Morning Star   The Morning Star will extend longer than normal.

-----
Items
-----

Items can be very useful in the game. Many items have properties that
magic will not be able to replicate. The different types of items in
the game are, items that recover your HP/MP, cure your status, sold for
money, open doors and create new routes, and items that can affect your
status. Items can only be used a certain number of times, so make sure
you are stocked up before you go exploring different caves.

-----------
Leveling Up
-----------

Every time you defeat a monster you will gain Experience and Gold.
After gaining a certain amount of Experience you will gain a level. A
message will appear on the screen telling you that your character
leveled up, and that your HP/MP has also been restored. Now a new
screen will appear. It asks you to choose what type of stat you want to
boost. This will allow you to custom make a character. You can create a
very powerful character in terms of physical attacks, a very powerful
magician with strong magic attacks, or anything in between.

The stat you choose will be the primary stat that will be boosted, some
stats will also boost a different stat, but to a lesser degree.

Types of Stat Growth
--------------------

Power

section: This will increase the Power rating of your character by 2 points. This
text:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
This will increase the Power rating of your character by 2 points. This
will raise the attack power of your character making it easier to
defeat monsters. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings
by 1 point.

Stamina
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
This will increase the Stamina rating of your character by 2 points.
This raises your HP and also concentrates on your character's defense.
You will now have less damage dealt to you by enemy attacks. This will
also increase your Power and Will ratings by 1 point.

Wisdom
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
This will increase the Wisdom rating of your character by 2 points.
This will give you additional MP and raise the damage caused by your
Magic attacks to your enemies. This will also increase your Stamina and
Will ratings by 1 point.

Will
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
This will increase the Will rating of your character by 2 points. This
will increase the speed of your gauge allowing your Will Bar to fill up
quicker. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1
point.

-----------------
Status Conditions
-----------------

-> There are four different types of status changes that your character
can be afflicted with. These conditions are caused by attacks from
enemies.

1. Poison
---------
Effect- Character loses HP's rapidly
Remedy- Magic of Heal or Pure Potion

2. Darkness
-----------
Effect- Character is blind
Remedy- Magic of Heal or Eye Drop

3. Petrified
------------
Effect- Character is turned to stone and unable to move
Remedy- Magic of Heal or Soft Potion

4. Moogle
----------
Effect- Character is changed to a furry creature and Def drops to 0
Remedy- Magic of Heal or Moogle Potion


=======================================================================
III. Characters
=======================================================================

--> Characters

HERO:
-----
He is the main character of the game. A prisoner at Glaive castle, he
escapes and embarks on a grand adventure.

Weapon: A variety of weapons and magic.
ASK: None

-------------------------------
Non-Playable Characters (NPC's)
-------------------------------

GIRL:
-----
Found early on in the game, she will heal your HP when you ASK her.

Weapon: None
ASK: She will slowly regenerate your HP's.

MAN:
----
He is in the Marsh Cave and will join you in your.

Weapon: Attacks with a magic fireball.
ASK: Information on using the Mattock.

AMANDA:
-------
She is one of the Hero's friends, and a fellow fighter from the past.
She will join you in the Cave of Medusa.

Weapon: Attacks with a Dagger.
ASK: Will heal the condition petrify.

LESTER:
-------
He is the brother of Amanda. You first see him as a parrot inside
Davias's Mansion. He will join you upon breaking the spell that is upon
him.

Weapon: He will attack with Arrows.
ASK: He will change the background music.

WATTS:
------
He will join you in the mine and sell you various items when you ASK
him. Watts will also make you the silver equipment once you have
completed the necessary steps.

Weapon: Attacks with an Axe
ASK: Will let you buy Items.

BOGARD:
-------
A powerful Gemma Knight, he will help you save the girl who is found on
the Airship

Weapon: He will attack with a Sword.
ASK: He will teach you how to use MAX attacks.

CHOCOBO:
--------
A baby bird you find and will serve as your transportation during
different parts of the game. The ASK command will let you ride him or
get off.

Weapon: None
ASK: He will give you a ride on its back. While riding the Chocobo, any
enemy cannot harm you.

MARCIE:
-------
Marcie is a robot built by Dr. Bowow. Marcie has being living in the
Dime Tower.

Weapon: It will attack with a Laser Beam.
ASK: Your MP will be restored to its full.

---------------
Supporting Cast
---------------

Willy:
------
He is the Hero's best friend, and will tell the hero about the Mana
Tree and the Knights of Gemma.

Hasim:
------
A young Gemma Knight who will die trying to get the Girl to Bogard.

Cibba
-----
He is a respected elder living at Wendel. He will tell you what
happened in the past when Vandole acquired the power of Mana.

Dr. Bowow
---------
An inventor at Ish, he will mechanize the Chocobo, who is then
transformed into the Chocobot. The Chocobot can travel across the
oceans.

--------
Villains
--------

Dark Lord:
----------
He is the emperor of the Empire of Glaive and the main villain in the
game. He is in search of the Mana Tree so he may become more powerful.

Julius:
-------
The survivor of Vandole, his goal in life is to destroy the Gemma
Knights. He is the Dark Lord's trusty servant, and will try to defeat
the Hero.


=======================================================================
IV. Walkthrough
=======================================================================

Note: I have divided my walkthrough into different sections. Each
section has a topic name. Below the topic name is a list of items that
are found, and a list of items that are necessary to complete each
section.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.1  Shards of Truth -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Nothing

The Hero starts his journey in a room next to the Battle Arena. Once
the hero walks west into the Arena, a monster(The Jackal), will come
out of the north gate.
______________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          JACKAL
Recommended Level:  1
GP:                 0
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Sword
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: This boss is very easy. It has no attacks and moves in a "w"
pattern. He will not move below the midpoint of the screen, so as long
as you don't move your character up too much, you won't even get hit.

section: After 8 or 9 hits the monster will be defeated.
text:
After 8 or 9 hits the monster will be defeated.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once the Jackal is defeated a small narrative will begin. After this
narrative you will find yourself next to the bed of your best friend
Willy. He tells you to go find Bogard at the falls and to tell him what
has happened.

* B-Floor 2 * Once you are able to move your character go north one
screen. Then talk to the Amanda (the female person walking around).
Amanda will play a major role in your quest, so be sure to pay
attention to what she has to say. Once the conversation is over go east
one screen and walk up the stairs.

* Floor 1 * Now go west one screen. Here you have to fight another
monster.

______________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          JACKAL2
Recommended Level:  1
GP:                 0
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Sword
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: Follow the same strategy as before.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once the monster is defeated look at the gate and you will notice that
it is still open. So, go north through the gate to the next screen.
Next, climb down the castle wall and go west one screen. Here you find
the Dark Lord and Julius talking together. They are looking for the
Mana Tree. After the conversation ends you are seen by the Dark Lord
and chased. The Dark Lord will then push you over the waterfall. Your
character drops 5 screens and then hits the ground! After a couple of
hours the Hero wakes up at the bottom of the waterfall.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.2  Topple -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Nothing

From the bottom of the falls walk east two screens, south, east, and
north. You will now be in the town of Topple. Buy any supplies that you
need. I recommend that you buy a couple Cure Potions if you had any
trouble dealing with the monsters. While you were fighting, some of the
monsters may have left behind a piece of Candy. By using Candy you can
recover some of your HP's. Now exit the town.

Now go south, and then east one screen. There will be a girl yelling
for help! Defeat the monster and talk to the injured man. He tells you
to bring the girl to Wendel and to see Bogard. Hmm... this Bogard must be
an important man. Hasim, the injured man, will then die. Once he dies
the Girl will join your group. The Girl has the ability to recover your
HP's if you ASK her.

As you continue to fight, you will gain exp and eventually a level up.
When you level up, you will have the choice to boost certain
attributes. The most profitable way for you to raise your attributes is
to have them balanced. For example, choose Power one time, and then
choose Wisdom the next.

Fight around this general area until you reach level 3 or 4. Once you
have over 140 gold, go to Topple and buy the Iron Helmet. Don't forget
to equip it! Make sure that you also buy 1 set of Keys at the Item
shop.

Exit Topple and go east two screens. From here, go south, east, north,
west, north, west three times, and north two screens. Then follow the
vines around and go south to the next screen. Now go west a screen and
climb the vine north to the next screen. Enter Bogard's house.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.3  Bogard -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Set of Mattocks
Items Needed: 1 Mattock

Talk to the old man three times, and on the third time he will reveal
his identity. Bogard will talk about what happened many years ago when
Vandole tried to gain the power of Mana. The story goes as follows... A
woman wearing the pendant, (the Girls mom) gave the Gemma knights hope,
which enabled them to beat Vandole.

Bogard will then tell you to go see Cibba in Wendel for more
information. He then opens the door to his back room. Go north into the
room and open the treasure chest for a Mattock. If you want to use the
Mattock, go to the Item screen and double click the Mattock. Whenever
you want to use an item, hit the "B" button. Unequip the Mattock so you
don't accidentally use it.

From Bogard's house, go south, east, north, south on the other side of
the mountains, and east twice. Then climb down the vine and go into the
East Cave.

East Cave
---------
Items Found: None
Items Needed: 1 Mattock

* Floor 1 * Go to the southern end of the screen, and use the Mattock
to clear a path. After clearing the path, go south two screens and up
the stairs.

Now go east twice, south, and east. Go into the little house in the
middle of the screen. The man offers to sell a Battle Axe for 150 gold.
Buy the Battle Axe and also a Pure Potion. Equip the Battle Axe and
exit the house. Then go east, south twice, and west three screens. Now
enter the building. (As you walked to the building, you may have
noticed that you couldn't deal any damage to the Swamp Man. Some
monsters are protected against some weapons, so experiment to see which
weapons or magic will work on which monsters)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.4  Kett's House -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Cure Spell
Items Needed: Nothing

Talk to the man by the door and he will tell you that "the room to the
east is only for Mr. Lee". In the room to the north there are two
people. One of them says the key to the Marsh Cave can be found in the
Lizardmen's nest to the south. The other person says that the man threw
away a mirror in the Cave of Marsh.

Go south from that room, and walk west into another room. Now walk
north through the door. Next, go north and walk onto the unoccupied
beds. Just before you go to sleep the Girl will find the Book of Cure
and give it to you. The Hero will learn the Cure spell. When you wake
up in the morning the Girl is gone. Ask the man guarding Mr. Lee's room
and he will "say" that he hasn't seen her.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.5  The Bronze Key -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Bronze Key
Items Needed: Nothing

From outside Kett's house, go east three times, and then south. Fight
all the lizards. Once they are defeated, a treasure chest will pop up
in the middle of the screen. Now open the treasure chest, go to the
item screen, and equip the Bronze Key. Now go north one screen, east,
and then north. Now go through the door into the Marsh Cave.

* This is a tip on how to gain some quick levels. If you defeat all the
monsters in once screen you will notice that if you exit a screen and
then go back in, that the monsters will not be there. However, there is
a way to get them back. You must go through three other different
screens and then go to the screen where you killed the monsters. The
monsters will be replenished. Monsters will also be replenished if
there is one or more monsters still alive on the screen. So what you
need to do is first, fight all the monsters in a screen, but leave one
alive. Then exit the screen and go back in. The monsters will have been
replenished. You can do this as many times as you want. This trick will
let you gain a huge amount of gold and experience. This trick works
especially well in the screen with the Lizard Men.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.6  Marsh Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Iron Shield, Fire Spell, Mirror
Items Needed: 4 Mattocks, 3 Keys

* Floor 1 * As soon as you enter the cave, you will see a man wandering
around on the screen. Talk to him and let him join your group. Now walk
north, west, and then step on the odd tile near the south wall. Then go
down the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go east a screen, and then climb down the vine that is at
the end of the log bridge. Now go west a screen, and then go back into
the cave.

* Floor  3* Now go east one screen. Use a Mattock in the middle of the
south wall to make a pathway. Go south a screen and go down across the
ice to get the Sickle. Equip the Sickle and use it to cut down the
vines around you. Then, backtrack to where you met the man wandering
around. (The entrance/exit room of the cave)

* Floor 1 * Now go south. (You can kill the blobs with the man's
fireballs) Use a Mattock on the west wall, and go west through the
opening. If you want to go to the Healing Spring to restore your HP and
MP follow these directions, if you don't just skip over this section
and read on. (Use a Key and go north. Then push the treasure chest onto
the odd tile and go down the stairs. Go south and search the bottom of
the pond. It will heal your HP and MP). From the room where you had the
option to find the Healing Spring, go west twice, and then north. Use a
Key on the east door, and then go through it. Once all the monsters are
defeated, a chest will appear. Open the treasure chest for an Iron
Shield. Equip the Iron Shield and go west through the door. Use the
Sickle to cut down the vines and go north. Then walk east a screen, and
use a Mattock on the rock in the northeast corner of the room. Then
walk down the stairs to the next floor.

* Floor 2 * Climb along the vines and go south. Then go west and into
the cave. Then go west, south, use a Key on the door and go through it.
Kill the monsters and slide east on the northern most row of ice. Use a
Mattock to break the rock, and then go south and break the southern
most rock. Step on the switch, save your game, and equip the Cure
spell. Now go down the stairs.

section: * Floor 3 * Go east a screen to battle the boss monster of this cave.
text:
* Floor 3 * Go east a screen to battle the boss monster of this cave.
______________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Hydra
Recommended Level:  13
GP:                 94
EXP gained:         10
Attacks:            Fireballs
Best Equipment:     Sickle
Items Gained:       Magic Book of Fire, Mirror

Strategy: To defeat this monster move north as the monster moves south.
Then attack the heads as the monster comes up. Once he is moving to the
top of the screen go south. Then once the Hydra goes down, move up and
attack the heads. This strategy sounds harder than it really is when
you are playing the game. The Iron Shield is able to block any
fireballs and your Sickle can destroy any of the fireballs. The only
real danger is if the Hydra hits you with his body. Keep on doing this

until the Hydra dies.
_______________________________________________________________________

After defeating the Hydra two treasure chests will appear. Open the
first one to learn the spell Fire. Destroy the chest with your weapon
and open the second for the Mirror. The Man tells you to show it to the
man at Kett's and then the man disappears. You are then warped back
outside the cave. Travel back to Kett's and save your game outside the
building.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.7  Kett's Dungeon -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Chain Flail, Sleep Spell
Items Needed: 5 Mattocks, 2 Keys

* Floor 1 * Equip the Mirror and talk to the man guarding the door. He
will turn into a Werewolf. Kill him and then go restore your HP and MP
at the beds where you found the Cure Spell. (In this cave the Face Orbs
and Pirates can only be hurt by the Fire magic). Starting from the room
where you fought the Werewolf, go east twice, north, west and up the
stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go south and use a Mattock on the east wall. Go east
through the hole, north, east, south twice, and west. Use a Mattock to
break one of the pots, and then step onto the odd tile. Then go down
the new stairs in the southeast corner.

* Floor 1 * Go east, north, and use a Key to open the door. Then go
north through the door and open the chest to find a Chain Flail. Equip
the Chain Flail and use it on the east pole to pull yourself across.
Step on the odd tile to remove the blocks that are in your way. Now go
south twice, west and up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go up the stairs to the north.

* Floor 3 * Now go west a screen and use the Chain Flail to pull
yourself across the chasm. Then go west a screen and then south down
the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Now go west a screen, and then north. Kill all the
creatures and let your Attack Meter be filled to the MAX. Then use the
Chain to go across the gap. (If you accidentally fall in the gap, go
north a screen, and up the stairs. Then go south through the door to
the room where you fell through the gap). Then, go east twice, north,
and west. Push the treasure onto the odd tile, and then go down the
stairs. (If you accidentally destroy the treasure chest, go out of the
room and then come back in. A new treasure chest will be there)

* Floor 1 * Now use a Mattock on the southeast pot, and then go down
the stairs.

* B-Floor 2 * Go east and use a Key on the door to the south. Go south
through the door. Open the second coffin going from right to left, on
the bottom row, to find the Girl. (Remember that you can ASK the girl
and she will recover your HP) Now you have backtrack to the entrance of
Kett's house.

(Go north, west, and up the stairs. Then go north up more stairs. Go
south and use a Mattock to break the pots. Then go south a screen and
walk up the stairs. Then go east, use the Chain, east, and down the
stairs. Then go east, north twice, west, south, west, north and then
down the stairs. Then go east, south, and west)

Make sure you save your game and heal before west to the entrance of
Kett's. Now go west through the door. Mr. Lee is in this room... but

section: instead of meeting a human, you meet a vampire!

instead of meeting a human, you meet a vampire!

BOSS Name:          Mr. Lee
Recommended Level:  15
GP:                 10
EXP gained:         11
Attacks:            Bats
Best Equipment:     Chain, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Magic Book of Sleep

Strategy: This battle is very easy. You notice that the Mr. Lee, will
only move to 4 locations on the screen. He can move to either position
adjacent to him. However, he will not jump to the position directly
across from him.

/-------\  He attacks by opening his cape and launching bats at you.
|   x   |  Luckily, you are able to block the bats with your shield.
|x     x|  The best strategy to defeat him is to block/dodge the bats
|   x   |  with your shield, and then hit him with the Chain Flail. I
|       |  was able to beat him without getting hit once using this
\-------/  strategy. Dodge his bats and then strike at him. If you run
           low on HP you can either use the Cure Spell, or ASK the Girl

to cure your wounds.
_______________________________________________________________________

After defeating Mr. Lee you will get the Magic Book of Sleep. You are
then warped outside of Kett's House. The Girl will tell you to travel
to Wendel. From outside Kett's, go east three times, south, west, cut
down the vines, and then go south. Then go west, north, and use the
Chain Flail to go across the river. Then go south, east, south twice,
east, and then north twice.

Once in Wendel, go east and you will meet the Man who helped you in the
Marsh Cave. Go to the Weapon Shop, buy the Iron Armor and sell any
excess items that you might have. From the outside the Weapon Shop, go
east, and north. Walk into the temple and go north to find Cibba.

Cibba tells the Girl to stand on the circle. Once the Girl stands on
the circle her mother appears. She tells the Girl to guard the Mana
Tree with the Gemma knights. Suddenly, the Man who helped you at the
cave shows up and says that the town is under attack. He then runs to
the Girl and says that he is going to take her to a hiding place. The
man who helped you turns into Julius. He then takes the Girl and runs
outside. When you are able to move, exit the temple and walk south
towards the town entrance. You have the option to avoid or kill the
monsters in your path. Once you catch up with Julius outside town, he
will zap you with his magic. When you wake up, you will find yourself
in the temple with Cibba. Cibba tells you that Julius took the Girl
away in the airship. He then gives you the magic spell Heal.

From outside Wendel, go west, south, and west. Now cut down the tree to
the west that is directly above the sand with your Battle Axe. Then go
west twice, and into the cave.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.9  Dwarf Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Nothing

Once you are inside the cave, talk to some of the dwarves. One will
tell you that you need to buy some Oil for the trolley tracks. You also
learn that Gaia Cave likes Silver, and that you can find Silver in the
Mine to the north.

Exit the Dwarf Cave and go north one screen. Then, use the Chain to go
across the stream. Then go south twice, east, and into the Item shop.
Buy an Oil for 500 gold, and exit the store.

Now go north a screen, use the Chain to get across the stream, and go
north twice. Now you need to equip the Battle Axe so you can chop down
the trees in the northwest corner of the screen. Now go north a screen
and chop some more trees.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.10  Silver Mine -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Silver
Items Needed: Oil, 5 Mattocks

* Floor 1 * Use the Oil on the cart and make sure you have your Sickle
equipped. You need the Sickle to change the tracks your cart is riding
on by hitting the second and third switch. Jump into the mine cart and
you will travel west two screens. Don't hit this switch. Now be patient
until you reach the next switch as the mine cart goes through two
screens west, one south, and one east. The switch you need to hit is
near the beginning of the screen and it is north of the tracks. After
hitting this switch you will travel south one screen where you have to
hit another switch on the east side of the tracks. Now the track will
lead to a pile of rocks, which your cart will hit. You are knocked down
into the mineshaft. (If you miss or hit the wrong switch, keep on
trying until you get it right. There is no time penalty in this cave)

* B-Floor 2 * At the bottom of the mineshaft you will meet Watts. He
will join your group and help you look for Silver. If you are low on
supplies, ASK Watts and he'll let you buy some of the Items he is
carrying. Watts also sells X-Cure, which can not be bought until later
on in the game. From here, go north and use a Mattock to break the
boulder at the north portion of the screen. Then go east and through
the door. Break the boulder farthest to the west, and then go south.
Use the pond to restore you HP and MP. Then go north and use a Mattock
on the boulder farthest east. Now use a Mattock on the east wall, and
then go through the hole. Use a Mattock on the pot and stand on the odd
tile. Now slide east on the ice, and then go down the stairs.

* B-Floor 3 * Go west twice and back into the cave. Go west, north, and
up the stairs.

* B-Floor 2 * Go west and down the stairs.

* B-Floor 3 * Prepare yourself to fight the boss monster. Then climb

south down the vine.
______________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Megapede
Recommended Level:  19
GP:                 161
EXP gained:         48
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Chain, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Silver

Strategy: The Megapede will come out of one of the four holes. It
travels in a normal or sideways figure 8 motion. Wait for him at a
hole, and then hit it in the head. The Megapede will not receive any
damage if you hit him on the body. Make sure you have at least 20 HP
when you defeat it, because it will explode and deal your character a
fair amount of damage. Once it is defeated, open the treasure chest for
the Silver.
_______________________________________________________________________

You are transported outside the cave and Watts leaves with the Silver
to make weapons and armor. He tells you to meet him in the Dwarf Cave.
Now go back to the Dwarf Cave (east, south three times, west and into
the cave). Once you are in the Dwarf Cave go south and buy the Silver
sword, armor, and shield from Watts. Exit the Dwarf Cave and go north
twice, west, and then north one screen. Now go into the cave.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.11  Gaia's Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Nothing

Go west, south, and then walk south between two statues. Once you walk
between the statues the door will shut. So go back up partway between
the statues and as soon as the door opens, go back south and through
the door. Then go up the stairs in the southeast corner of the room.
Once you are outside the cave Bogard will join your group. He tells you
that the Airship it refueling at the lake to the north.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.12  Refueling Lake -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Nothing

Now go south, cut a path through the trees, and then go west a screen.

(If you paid close attention, you will have noticed that the screen you
just went through had four werewolf creatures. These creatures can all
be killed, and then be replenished. They are all also situated in a
small clearing right next to the border of the screen... which means
that this is a very, very, easy place to level. First go one screen
west of them, and then go back right and start swinging your weapon,
preferably your sword, as fast as you can. You will be able to defeat
them all, most likely suffering only one hit. I was able to gain 10
levels in 20 minutes here)

Then go north twice, you should see an Inn above you. Now use the
Battle Axe to chop the trees to your left and then go west twice. Now
go north and into the Item Shop. Buy the Silver Helmet, a set of Keys,
and a set of Mattocks. After exiting the shop, go east twice, north,
east through the trees to the next screen. Then wait until you attack
bar is at the Max and use the Chain Flail to cross the stream. Then go
north, east, use the Chain Flail, and then west. Then go down the vine
and west. Use the Chain Flail to go across the water and then go south.
Now go west and north twice. Then climb the chain and go up into the
Airship

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.13  Airship -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Pendant (Temporarily)
Items Needed: 1 Key, 1 Mattock

* Floor 1 * Starting from the deck, go north a screen along the west
side of the mast. Go west, south and through the door.

* B-Floor 2 * Go west three times, north, east and then down the
stairs.

* B-Floor 3 * Now go west a screen, and then south a screen. Walk onto
the odd tile in the northeast corner of the screen and then stand on
the odd tile in the northwest corner. Stairs will appear in the
southeast corner. Now go down the stairs.

* B-Floor 4 * Go west twice, use a Key on the south door, and then go
south. The Girl is being kept in a jail cell. Walk south to the jail
door. Once you do this, the Airship will begin to move. The Girl can't
open the gate, but she thinks she can escape through the window. But...
she will need some help to do this. Now you have to find a path that
will lead to the outside window. Bogard will decide to remain behind
once you try to go north. From the room where the Girl is, go north a
screen, east twice and up the stairs.

* B-Floor 3 * Now go north, west, and then up the stairs.

ASK the Chocobo. You can now ride on the Chocobo. When riding on the
Chocobo, you are not able to kill any monsters, but monsters can't
attack you either.

While you were walking, you might have noticed a group of four Werewolf
monsters. These monsters will let you gain quick and easy levels since
they are always replenished, even if you kill all of them. To kill them
quickly, you must have a throwing type of weapon equipped. Then go to
the screen south of the monsters and wait for your attack bar to max
out. Then go north and let your weapon fly, which will kill all the
creatures in one shot (if you have sufficient Power stats). You can
repeat this over and over again, until you are satisfied with your
level.

next to Davias is Amanda's brother! If you talk to the boy next to the

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Gold Armor, Ice Spell, Amanda's Tears
Items Needed: Mattock, 2 Keys

Dismount from your Chocobo. Now walk a sideways figure 8 around the
palm trees. (You might have to do it 2 or 3 times until the cave opens)

           - -   - -       (x) = Palm tree
           - x - x -       (-) = Path you walk
           - -   - -

Walk into the cave and you will see Amanda. She says she took the
Pendant in exchange for her brother. Despite this, Davias cursed her
brother changing him into a parrot. Amanda is looking for the Tears of
Medusa. After a short discussion Amanda will join your group.

* Floor 1 *  From where you found Amanda, go south and use a Mattock on
the south wall. Then go south through the new entrance. Then go west
twice, south, west twice and north three times. Then go west, use a
Key, south, and kill all the enemies in the room. Then open the chest
for a suit of Gold Armor. Then go north, east and use a Key on the
north door. Then go north through the now open door. There are two odd
tiles here. The one closet to the bottom opens the door, and the other
one closes the door. Have your Chain Flail weapon equipped. Go west,
and then onto the bottom patch of ice, which will bring you onto the
first odd tile. Then use the Chain Flail on the post to the east. Now
go east to the next screen. Open the treasure for the Ice Spell. Now go
west and south three times. (If you want, you can use a Key on the west
door. Go through the door and go to the bottom of the pond. It will
restore your HP and MP) From the room adjacent to the recovery
fountain, go south, east and use a Mattock on the north wall. Go
through the wall, and then move the frozen snowman onto the tile. (If
you mess up, the far right ice square will let you back down) Then go
north through the door. Use your Ice Spell to freeze and enemy. Then
push the frozen enemy onto the odd tile. (Be careful, because Amanda
might accidentally destroy the snowman that you just made, and this
time, you have to use the usual method to have the monsters
replenished) Then go north through the door, and down the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Now go north and down the stairs.

* Floor 3 * Climb down the vine, and just before you go west, heal-up,

BOSS Name:          Medusa
Recommended Level:  28
GP:                 88
EXP gained:         90
Attacks:            Shoots Snakes
Best Equipment:     Wind Spear/Chain Flail, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Drop of Amanda's Tears

Strategy: The Medusa shoots three or four snakes out of her head. Stay
below her and just dodge the snakes. Just keep on attacking Medusa's
head and she will eventually die.
_______________________________________________________________________

The Medusa dies, but she leaves no tears. Just as you are ready to
leave, Amanda says she was injured and will soon turn into a Medusa.
She asks you to kill her and take her tears to her brother. You then
kill Amanda. Search her body for the tears. Once you have done this,
you will be transported out of the cave.

Take your Chocobo with you and go back to Jadd. (s,e,n,n,n,w,n,w,n) Now
go back to Davias's Mansion. Some of these monsters are invulnerable to
the Wind Spear. I recommend using the Silver Sword.

* Floor 1 * Go up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go east twice into the room where you first saw Davias and
the bird. Davias is gone, but the bird is still there. Equip Amanda's
Tears and talk to the bird. He transforms into Lester and joins you
group. Now go down the stairs.

* Floor 1 * Now go east twice and use a Mattock on the north wall. Go
north twice and use a Key on the door to the west. Go west through the
door and go south a screen. Now walk around the tiles counter-clock
wise and go up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go west four times. Now walk onto the odd tile one space
north of the iron fence. Now walk counter clockwise until some stairs
appear. Now you go down the stairs.

* Floor 1 * Then go north, west, and south four times. Then use the Ice
Spell to freeze the monster. Push him onto the odd tile and go east.
Kill all the enemies in this room and a treasure will appear. Open the

BOSS Name:          Davias
Recommended Level:  30
GP:                 98
EXP gained:         95
Attacks:            Throws Fireballs
Best Equipment:     Were Axe, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: Davias is protected by four circling balls of flame. He
attacks by shooting a ball of flame at you. He moves east and west
across the top of the screen. There are two approaches to defeating
Davias. The quickest way is to stay between the circle of fireballs
surrounding Davias, and just keep on slashing him with your Were Axe.
The longer way to kill Davias is to stay at the bottom of the screen
and dodge the fireballs Davias releases. Once your weapon is powered up
let it fly at Davias. I have defeated Davias this way and have not been

hit by Davias's fireballs once.
_______________________________________________________________________

After Davias dies you are transported back to the town of Jadd.

Strategy: The Metal Crab moves across the top/bottom of the screen. It

corner of the screen. The Metal Crab is unable to hit you from here.

4.20  Golem Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Morning Star, Lit Spell
Items Needed: 1 Mattock, 2 Keys

First off, this cave is very complex. However, if you follow my
directions, you should have no problem going through this cave. This
cave contains many screens that warp you back to the first screen.

* Floor 1 * Go north, east twice, and use a Mattock on the north wall.
Go north and then west. On this screen there are four treasure chests
and four odd tiles. Place one treasure box onto a tile and then knock
it off the tile to open the door. Go north and then east. Use a Key to
open the door and go through it. Go east, south three times, east twice
and up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Now save your game and heal-up. Go east to begin the

battle.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Cyclops
Recommended Level:  37
GP:                 63
EXP gained:         71
Attacks:            Mace
Best Equipment:     Were Axe, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Morning Star

Strategy: The Cyclops moves to three main points, each of which is on
the east side of the screen. Occasionally he will charge horizontally.
Stay below him as he charges across the screen and use the Were Axe to
hit him. Once he reaches the bottom of the screen go above him. Then
hit him as he makes his way up. Follow this general pattern until the
monster is defeated.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once he is vanquished open the treasure for a Morning Star. Equip this
weapon, which adds +10 to your attack. This weapon also is able to
break down the same objects and walls your Mattock can... so you can
now get rid of all your Mattocks.

* Floor 1 * Now go west three times and you will be back at the
entrance. Go north, heal-up and save your game. Use a Key on the door

and go north.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Golem
Recommended Level:  39
GP:                 96
EXP gained:         172
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Morning Star, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Spell Book of Lit

Strategy: The only weapon that you should be using to defeat the Golem
is the Morning Star. The Golem can charge vertically and diagonally.
Stay at the bottom of the screen for the entire battle. When he charges
down move out of the way and hit him with the Morning Star. Do this
until the Golem dies.
_______________________________________________________________________

He will give you the spell Lit. Now go north, use the Morning Star on
the rocks and go up the stairs to the next floor.

* Floor 2 * Climb the vine and go east. Then try to go into the cave.
Just as you try, the bridge behind you collapses. Your character then
comes out next to a waterfall. Now go east twice and into the castle.

* Floor 1 * Try going through the main gate to the castle and you will
discover that it is locked. You need to find another entrance... so
walk west a screen. Now chop some trees down and go west again. Then go
north a screen and walk into the door.

* B-Floor 2 * Cross the bridge to the north, then the bridge to the

* Floor 2 * Now go north another screen.

* Floor 5 * (That last vine brings you up a few floors) Now go down the

Best Equipment:     Morning Star, Cure Spell

Strategy: The monster flies above you and drops two flaming bombs with
its wings. Soon after doing this, the Chimera will fly down in a
zigzagging type motion. The method that I used to defeat the Chimera
was to simply stand near the top of the screen and attack as quickly as
I could, curing occasionally. This worked well enough for me, so I am
leaving it up to you if you want to fight the Chimera a different way.

corner of the screen.

* Floor 2 * Now go west three times, south, and into the door.

* Floor 2 * Now go north, east, south twice, east, use a Key on the
door and go east. Kill the enemies and go to the bed to restore your HP
and MP. Then go west three times. The room here has four empty chests
on the odd tiles. Do not knock any of them off or the stairs will
vanish. I used the Chain Flail to kill the monsters in the room. Now go
down the stairs.

* Floor 1 * Go east twice and use a Mattock on the east wall. Now go

* Floor 2 * Go south, east, and kill all the enemies. Open the chest

* Floor 3 * Go south and west twice. Now freeze two monsters using the
Ice spell, and put the snowmen on the odd tiles. Then go down the

* Floor 2 * Go west, north, and up the stairs.

* Floor 3 * Then go north, west, heal-up and save your game. Then go up

* Floor 2 * The Dark Lord is at the top of the castle. The Girl will

Strategy: The Dark Lord will run around and try to hit you with his

The Girl is by the edge of the falls! The Hero asks what is wrong, but

Apparently, he has hypnotized the Girl! He tells the Girl to use the
pendant so the waterfall will be reversed. Once the waterfall starts to
flow backwards, Julius will zap you with his magical power. Your
character then falls down the waterfall AGAIN!

Your Chocobo finds you and brings you to a house in Ish. You wake up

4.26  Ice Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Elixir, Ice Sword

From the outside of Lorim go south, west, north twice, west, (chop the
trees), and go north four screens. If you need some equipment, there is
an Item shop west one screen. Otherwise go east twice, south twice,
west, south, and east twice. Now go into the cave.

* Floor 1 * Go north, walk counter-clockwise around the ice and go
north. Go walk to the odd tile and step on it. Go south to the wall and
wait for the snowman. Then push him north onto the odd tile. Go east,
use the Flame Chain and go north. Use the Chain to cross the ice and go
west. Use a Key on the north door and go north. Go east, east, use a
Key on the door, go north, and then walk up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go north, west, and onto the ice. Once you are off the ice
walk around the rocks and get back onto the ice. Once you have stopped
sliding you should be in a room with stairs going down. Now take the
bottom left ice path south. Once you are off the ice, walk around the
rocks and back on the ice. Once you are off the ice go onto the single
path of ice in the middle, which will take you west. Once you are off
the ice use a Mattock/ Morning Star on the north wall. Then go north,
and up the stairs.

* Floor 3 * Use a Mattock/Morning Star on the north wall. Go north to

west a screen. Then go south to room full of enemies. Kill all of the

* Floor 4 * Go east and then go back into the cave.

* Floor 3 * Cross the ice using a Chain and go west twice. Then go
south and use the Chain to get to the middle. Step on the tile and go
on the northwest patch of ice. Then step on the odd tile in the
southeast corner. Then go south and east twice. (Use your axe to
destroy the bramble) Then step onto the east ice track. Once you are
off the ice step onto the ice to the south. Once you get off, use the
Chain to cross the ice and go west. Then use a Key on the north door
and go through. Then walk to the bottom of the lake, which will restore
your HP and MP. Then go onto the ice and west. You can use the Chain to
get off the ice. It is easier to get across using the post to the
north. Now use a Mattock/Morning Star on the west wall and go west
through the hole. Now use the Chain to go across the streams and then
go up the stairs.

* Floor 4 * Go east, and walk back into the cave.

* Floor 3 * Now go east, north, and up the stairs.
