BOSS Name:          Kary
Recommended Level:  46
GP:                 129
EXP gained:         181
Attacks:            Icicle Throw, Tail Lash
Best Equipment:     Flame Chain, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Ice Sword

Strategy: Kary is only vulnerable in the head region. Also, your Flame
Chain is able to destroy the icicles she throws at you. While fighting,
you may note that you aren't losing much HP when you are hit... this is
because of the Ice Armor that you purchased earlier! Kary's basic
movement pattern is to slither up and down on the right side of the
screen. While doing this, she shoots icicles across the screen and can
moves horizontally across the screen. She moves horizontally in three
different spots, top/middle/bottom. The best tactic to use is to stay
either above or below her and hit her head. When Kary finishes moving
across the middle ice, make your move to the opposite direction of

where Kary is moving.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once Kary is defeated a treasure chest will appear. Open the chest for
the Ice Sword and a transport out of the cave.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.27  Lich Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Bone Key, Nuke Spell
Items Needed: Nothing

Now walk back to Lorim. (w,w,n,e,n,n,w,w,s,s,s,s,e,s,s,e,n,n) Go north
into the throne room and talk to the king. Now you need to talk to
Cibba who is (s,e,n). He gives you the Bone Key and tells you to go to
a cave in the Plain of Floating Rocks to find the Legendary Sword.

Although the Hero is supposed to get the Legendary Sword now, I think
it is better to get the Nuke spell first. From the outside Lorim go
(s,w,n,n,w,s), go into the water, (n,n,n,n,w,n,n,w,w,w,n,n) get onto
dry land, (w,s,w,s,w,n) and into the cave.

* Floor 1 * Go down the stairs.

* B-Floor 2 * Go down the stairs again.

* B-Floor 3 * Now heal-up and save your game. Walk north to fight the

Lich.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Lich
Recommended Level:  48
GP:                 220
EXP gained:         198
Attacks:            Skulls
Best Equipment:     Morning Star, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Nuke Spell

Strategy: The Lich moves in a figure eight pattern. He will
occasionally deviate from the pattern, flying off the screen and
reappearing on the other side of the screen. He will then start the
figure eight pattern again. The best strategy is to have your Cure
spell equipped and have the Morning Star equipped. Just stand in the
middle of the screen and strike the Lich. The most damaging weapon that
the Lich possess are his flying skulls. However, the Morning Star and
other weapons will destroy the skulls that the Lich throws. If you hit
the Lich at the right time it will pass right over you without dealing
damage. If you do this properly the Hero won't take damage. Watch your
HP and just hit the Lich alternating with the Cure Spell until the Lich
dies. This is one of the toughest bosses, so if you die, keep on trying

until you win.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once the Lich is defeated you will get the final magic spell, Nuke.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.28  Legendary Sword -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Bone Key, 1 Key

The Hero now needs to find the Legendary Sword! You now need to find
the Plain of Floating Rocks. To get there, you need to follow (part of
the way) the same path you used to get the Ice equipment.

Here are a couple sets of directions. Each set of directions will lead
you to a certain point. There are then new directions on where to go.

From outside the Lich Cave go
(s,e,n,e,n,e,s,s,w,w,w,w,w,n,n,w,w,n,n,n,n,n,n,w,n,n,w,s) and onto dry
land.

From outside of Lorim, go
(s,w,n,n,w,s,n,n,n,n,w,n,e,e,e,e,e,s,s,s,e,s,s,s,s,w,n,n,w,s) and onto
dry land.

From the pier south of Wendel, go
(s,s,s,s,e,e,s,s,s,s,s,w,n,n,w,s) and onto dry land.

Now that you are on dry land, go north and then east a screen. Now use
the chain to go across stream, and go south twice, east, south three
times, and then west. You are now in the Plain of Floating Rocks. Use
the Morning Star to break rocks and go south. (There is an Item Shop
one screen to the west) Go south, east, south twice, west, north, and
across bridge Now go south twice and into Weapon shop. Buy the Thunder
Spear and exit the building. Now go south, east, south, east twice, and
north. If you want, you may buy supplies in the Magic Shop. Otherwise
go west and use the Bone Key on the Door. Now go into the Cave

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.29  Kraken's Cave -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: 1 Key

* Floor 1 * Go north, use a Key, north and use Mattock/Morning Star on
east wall. Now go east twice and step on the top tile, then bottom
tile, and go through the east door. Now go north twice and use a
Mattock/Morning Star on the north wall. Go north and down the stairs.

* B-Floor 2 * Heal-up and save your game. Go across the bridge and the
Kraken will come out of the water.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Kraken
Recommended Level:  47
GP:
EXP gained:
Attacks:            Tentacles
Best Equipment:     Thunder Spear, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: The Kraken comes from beneath you and uses its tentacles to
stab at your character. The best strategy is to stand directly above
the Kraken and stab down as fast as you can at the Kraken's head. The
shield will stop about 50% of the Kraken's tentacle blows. If you run
low on HP, use the Cure Spell. Also, the Kraken's explosion might
damage your character! Once the Kraken is defeated, a new entrance will

appear.
_______________________________________________________________________

Now exit the cave. You are now on an island. Go east, south, west,
north, and into the cave

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.30  Undersea Volcano -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Zues Axe
Items Needed: 2 Keys

Here is a quick note before you start exploring the cave. The enemies
in this cave are very strong, so watch you HP's!

* Floor 1 * Go south, west twice, north, and use a Mattock/Morning Star
on the west wall. Go west and use the Sickle to clear the vines. Then
use the Ice spell to freeze two enemies. Put them on the odd tiles.
Then go down the stairs.

* B-Floor 2 * Go west and through the door.

* B-Floor 3 * Go west, and then north a screen (Walk through the marsh
stuff as quickly as possible because it takes about 100 HP off) Walk
north, west, south, west, and south. Use a Key on the door and go south
again. Kill all the enemies and a treasure chest will appear. Open it
for the Zeus Axe. Now go north twice and use a Mattock/Morning Star on
the east wall. Now go east, north, east, and north. Now use a
Mattock/Morning Star to break the east wall. Go east through the hole
and down the stairs.

* B-Floor 4 * Go into the new cave opening.

* B-Floor 5 * Go north and east twice. Go south twice and go to the
bottom of the middle pond to restore your HP and MP. Go north and use a
Key on the door. Go east and destroy the bottom-right boulder using a
Mattock/Morning Star. Go down the stairs.

* B-Floor 6 * You are now in a screen with three doors. Pick the right
door.

* B-Floor 7 * Now go south, west, and north. Freeze two monsters and
put them on the odd tiles. Then, knock away a snowman and go down the
stairs

section: * B-Floor 8 * Heal-up and save your game. Go west to fight the Iflyte.
text:
* B-Floor 8 * Heal-up and save your game. Go west to fight the Iflyte.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Iflyte
Recommended Level:  50
GP:                 271
EXP gained:         213
Attacks:            Rolling Attack
Best Equipment:     Thunder Spear , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Rusty Sword

Strategy: This monster curls itself into a ball and rolls across the
screen. Eventually he will stop at the top of the screen and reveal his
body. You are able to strike the monster in his head when he is fully
revealed. You are also able to hit the monster when he is rolling in a
ball, if you strike directly at his center.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once the Iflyte dies you get the Rusty Sword. After your character
exits the cave, take you're Chocobot with you and go back to Cibba. He
tells you to find the Key to Dime Tower, and to talk to Dr. BowowSo now
go to Ish and talk to Dr. Bowow. Dr. Bowow says you can use the Nuke
spell to blow up a piece of crystal in the Desert of Crystal. The
Desert of Crystal is right outside of Ish.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.31  Cave of Ruins -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Dragon Shield, Dragon Sword,
Items Needed: Nothing

* From outside Ish go west, north twice, and west. There should be two
crystals near the middle of the screen. Use the Nuke spell on the right
crystal and it will reveal a hole. Go into the hole into the cave.

* Floor 1 * Go west twice and down the stairs.

* BFloor 2 * Go north, east, and open the chest for a Dragon Shield.
Then go west, north twice, west twice, and open the chest for a Dragon
Sword. Then go east four times, north three times, and west. Now heal-
up/save game.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Mantis Ant
Recommended Level:  53
GP:                 228
EXP gained:         219
Attacks:            Pincers
Best Equipment:     Dragon Sword , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: This fight is very easy, but remember that those spikes take
off a massive amount of HP! The Mantis Ant will stay near the top of
the screen and occasionally zigzag down at you. Use your sword on him
when he is at the top of the screen and dodge him when he comes down to
attack you. However, there is a much easier way to defeat this boss.
Have your Fire Spell equipped when you enter the battle. As soon as you
enter the screen don't move. Nothing will be able to hit you, and you
can cast the Fire Spell at the monster. I was able to win with 20 uses

of the spell.
_______________________________________________________________________

When you kill the Mantis Ant the east door opens. Go through the door
and equip the Rusty Sword. Then stand on the odd tile. The power of the
Rusty Sword is released and the Dime Tower will be raised.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.32  Dime Tower -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Dragon Armor
Items Needed: 2 Keys

By about this time you should be around level 55-60. From outside the
Cave of Ruins go south twice, east, south, and west. Try to walk across
the screen, and Dime Tower will rise up from the sands.

Or if you need to re-supply, go back to Ish. From outside of Ish, the
Dime Tower is south and west twice.

As soon as you walk in, Dr. Bowow's robot Marcie will join you. If you
ASK him he recovers your MP. There are tablets scattered throughout the
tower. I recommend reading them if you want to read about the story
line of this game. The directions I give do not include directions to
the tablets. If you are interested in reading them, use the map of this
tower.

* Floor 1 * Go west, north twice, east, and use a Mattock/Morning Star
on the east wall. Go through east, north, west, and up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Go west, south, east, south twice, east, and up the stairs.

* Floor 3 * Now climb the vine north a screen. Now go through the door.

* Floor 4 * Go west and use a Key on the north door. Go north, east,
and open the chest for the Dragon Armor. Go west and use a
Mattock/Morning Star on the west wall. Now go west and up the stairs.

* Floor 5 * Go south and go into a bed to rest. Your HP and MP will be
restored. Go north and up the stairs.

* Floor 6 * There are two monsters surrounded by trees to your south.
You need to freeze both monsters, which can be difficult, since you
don't want to kill them when you chop down the trees. Position your
character in the bottom corners, facing the walls away from the trees.
Now swing your Axe and the trees will be chopped and the enemies
unharmed. Now freeze the monsters and go north. Use a Key on the door
and go east. Go south and up the stairs.

* Floor 7 * Heal-up and save your game. Go north and the fight will

begin.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Garuda
Recommended Level:  55
GP:                 265
EXP gained:         221
Attacks:            Feathers
Best Equipment:     Flame Chain , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: Garuda will dive across the screen and throw feathers at you.
Garuda will also swoop down to the middle of the screen and drop more
feathers on you. The trick is to wait in the corner below, but at a
striking distance where the tip of your Flame Chain just reaches
Garuda. Use your Flame Chain to destroy the feathers Garuda drops and
to hit Garuda himself. When he swoops down he will miss you. Then go to
the other corner and attack Garuda again. Follow this pattern until the
monster is defeated.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once Garuda is killed go west twice. Just as you are ready to walk on
land, a part of the tower collapses. Marcie tells you that he will
throw you over and then jump himself. After he throws you across the
gap, the hero tells Marcie to jump. Sadly, Marcie is unable to... The
tower will then collapse carrying Marcie with it. The robot's last
words are for you to save the world. Once the tower collapses go west
three times to the waterfall. The waterfall fall will reverse its flow.
Walk into the waterfall and it will carry you up to the top of the

mountain.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.33  Tower of Gemma -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Exaclibur
Items Needed: 2 Keys

Once you are at the top, go west, north twice, and into the temple.

Some of the enemies that you fight here will drop very rare Items. The
Samurai Warriors will drop Elixirs or the Samurai Armor. The Demon Head
will drop an X-Ether or Samurai Helmet. The Elephant will drop the
Aegis Shield.

* Floor 1 * Go south, east twice, north twice, and use a Key on the
north door. Go north and up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Heal-up and save your game. Go north and a Dragon will
attack.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Dragon
Recommended Level:  57
GP:                 262
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            Fire Ball
Best Equipment:     Thunder Spear , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: The dragon will first move down the left side of the screen.
He then zigzags across the screen and goes up the right side of the
screen. He will then move across the top of the screen and follow the
same pattern. The dragon attacks with fireballs, which you can luckily
block with your shield. You may only attack the Dragon in the head, his
scales protect him from hits to the body. The Dragon is very slow, so

section: just dodge and then strike him until you win.
text:
just dodge and then strike him until you win.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once he is defeated go into the portal in the northeast corner.

* Floor 3 * Go east and into the portal.

* Floor 4 * Go north, west, north, and use a key on the door.
Go west and into the portal.

* Floor 5 * Go east and into the portal.

* Floor 6 * Go south and break the west wall. Go west twice, south,
west, and into the portal.

* Floor 7 * Now go west, and south twice. You need to use the Ice spell
and direct your icicle using the control pad. Hit the monster on the
odd tile and the door will open. Go east and up the stairs.

* Floor 8 * Heal-up and save your game. Go north and the Red Dragon
begins will attack.

____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Red Dragon
Recommended Level:  58
GP:                 257
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            Fire Ball
Best Equipment:     Thunder Spear , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: The only differences between this boss and the last are that
it moves in the opposite directions and it has more HP. However, the
strategy is still the same as for the first Dragon.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once he is defeated go into the portal.

* Floor 9 * Go west and into the portal.

* Floor 10 * Now go north, east, north and into the portal.

* Floor 11 * Go east and into the portal. Go south, east twice, and
into the portal.

* Floor 12 * Use a Key on the door and go west. Go to the bottom of the
pond to restore the Hero's HP and MP. Exit the room and go back into
the portal.

* Floor 11 * Go west, south, and into the portal. Go west and into the
portal.

* Floor 12 * Go east and use a Key on the door. Now go east through the
now open door, and go east twice more. In this room you need you need
to freeze a monster. Put the snowman on the odd tile directly above the
odd tile in the bottom-left corner. Once the door is open, go north
three times, and go up the stairs.

* Now heal-up and save your game. Go north and prepare to fight the

Dragon Zombie.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Dragon Zombie
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 270
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            Fire Ball
Best Equipment:     Thunder Spear , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: The Dragon Zombie is similar to the dragon you fought back at
the Cave of Marsh. The Dragon Zombie shoots fireballs from his mouths,
and will occasionly move across the screen. Have a long reach weapon
equipped and attack its head. Your weapon is able to destory the
fireballs and your shield can also block them. The fireballs don't deal
you much damage, but if you get hit by the Dragons body, you will lose
about 75 hit points.
_______________________________________________________________________

Once the monster is killed go into the portal.

* Floor 13 * Now go north four times and talk to the Lady (the Girls
mom). She transforms your Rusty Sword into the Excalibur. Go north
twice, west, south, and west. Heal-up and save your game.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4.34  Tree of Mana -
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Items Found: Nothing
Items Needed: Nothing

Go north to find Julius and the Girl. Now prepare to fight for the
future of the world!
____________________________________________________________________

The first time you have to battle Julius, he transforms himself into
three different Julius. Once they are defeated Julius transforms into a
powerful monster.

------------------------------------------
BOSS Name:          Julius (1)
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 818
EXP gained:         638
Attacks:            Nuke
Best Equipment:     Exacalibur , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: Just attack them and use the Cure spell until they are
defeated. Once they are defeated, Julius will use the power of Mana and
transform into a monster!

-------------------------------------------
BOSS Name:          Julius (2)
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 161
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            Thunder Bolts
Best Equipment:     Exacalibur , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: Julius shoots Thunder Bolts from his hands and swoops down.
Have the Exaclibur equipped and the Cure Spell. Dodge Julius when he
swoops down and hit him with your sword. This battle is fairly long but
Julius is fairly easy to beat!

-------------------------------------------
BOSS Name:          Julius (2)
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 ---
EXP gained:         ---
Attacks:            Nuke
Best Equipment:     Exacalibur , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Strategy:  Remember, now that the Girl is with you she can heal some HP
if you ASK her. Julius can transport himself to different spots on the
screen. The best strategy is to stay in the middle of the screen and
attack Julius when he appears.  Don't hesitate to use Elixir's, which

section: restore all HP and MP. Eventually you will prevail!
text:
restore all HP and MP. Eventually you will prevail!
_______________________________________________________________________

Congratulations!  Now relax and enjoy the ending... even though this is
one of the saddest endings that I have seen.

XI. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's)
=======================================================================

Last Updated: 11/01/2000

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Questions
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

-> This list is compiled from various emails that I have received.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1. What does the Ask command do?

A: The Ask command allows you to use the special abilities of certain
NPC's. The abilities of NPC's are very important to your quest.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2. I just got out of the town Jadd and I cannot find the cave of
Medusa. Could you help me out?

A: The Medusa Cave is hidden. To find the cave follow these directions.
From outside of Jadd, go south, east, south, south, east, south, south,
west, and north. Now dismount from your Chocobo. You should see two
separate palms trees to the north. Now walk a sideways figure 8 around
the palm trees. After walking a few complete sideways figure's 8 the
cave will open.

section: 3. I don't have any Keys or Mattocks left and the only way to go up a
text:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3. I don't have any Keys or Mattocks left and the only way to go up a
floor is to go through a locked door. Do I have to start a new game, or
is there something I can do?

A: There are two monsters that will leave these items behind. A
Skeleton will leave behind Keys when it drops a treasure chest. A
FaceOrb will leave behind Mattocks when it drops a treasure chest.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4. I am stuck behind a treasure chest and can't get by. Now what?

A: After opening a treasure chest, you can destroy it with your weapon.
If you can't open it, it's because you are full with other items. So,
throw a useless item into the Trash Can and open the treasure chest.

section: 5. I am near Jadd and I can't get past the poison gas. Help!?
text:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5. I am near Jadd and I can't get past the poison gas. Help!?

A: To get past the poison gas you have to kill Davias. To do this, you
first need to go to Davias's mansion, free Lester, and then help him
avenge his sister.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
6. What does the Morning Star do?

A: The Morning Star can attack enemies and break walls like Mattocks.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
7. I'm in the Cave of Ruins, and I just beat the Mantis Ant. I went
right into this room with waterfalls on each side, and a switch. I
stepped on the switch and nothing happened. What do I do?

A: To activate the switch, you must have the Rusty Sword equipped
before you step on the floor switch.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
8. Which crystal do I nuke?

A: From outside of Ish go one screen west, north twice, and west. There
are two crystals sticking out in the middle of the screen. The right
one is the one you nuke.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
9. What are the most powerful weapons and armor in the game, and where
can I find them.

A: The most powerful sword is the Excalibur and the most powerful armor
you can find is the Aegis Shield, Samurai Helmet, and the Samurai Armor?
These pieces of equipment can be found by killing certain enemies in
the Tower of Gemma. These are the three different monsters that may
leave behind a special weapon or piece of armor.

Monster       Treasure Chest

---------------------------------------
Ninja         Elixir or Samurai Armor
Demon Head    X-Ether or Samurai Helmet
Elephant      Aegis Shield


=======================================================================
XII. Tips, Tricks, and Strategies
=======================================================================

1. The Morning Star can also be used like a Mattock.

2. Ask Commands: You can take very good advantage of this command,
especially the ones that refuel your HP and MP.

3. Since NPC's attack in the direction that you move, you can help
guide their attacks.

4. Sound test: Press Down + B + Start at the title screen.

5. Easy Money/Exp: Enemies will return to a screen if...
      1) You visit three different screens and then go back or
      2) If you leave one monster in a screen and then come back. The
         monsters will have regenerated. This will let you gain money
         or exp very quickly.

6. Level Upgrades: When you increase in levels always alternate between
Power or Wisdom. This will lead to an even build up of status.

7. Selling Weapons: Never sell any of the main weapons unless you get
an upgraded version of it. Example: Only sell your Broad Sword after
you get the Silver Sword.

8. Killing People: It is possible to kill people in towns, but they
have a lot of HP. To defeat them, just keep on hitting them with your
weapon with the weapon at its max Will Power.

9. Treasure Chest Tip: This is a trick you can use throughout the game,
but is more helpful during the end of the game. What is in a treasure
chest is not determined when the chest appears, but instead when you
open it. This fact can be taken advantage of when trying to get the
Samurai Armor/Helmet and Aegis Shield. First, you must have your item
inventory full, but still have room in your Equipment inventory. Then
kill the monster carrying the equipment you want until one of them
drops a chest. Then try to open the chest. You will get a few "Can't
carry!" messages, but the chest will remain closed. Eventually you will
get armor instead of an item. This way you don't have to kill a ton of
those stupid elephants and only get those useless (as far as I can
tell) unicorn items, but instead need only get one to drop a chest.

10. If an empty treasure chest is blocking your path, you can destroy
it by attacking it with your weapon.

11. Warps-

Here are some fun tricks to try out!

Warp 2- In the cave where you get the Ice magic, go to the corner room
right before you get the Ice magic. Equip a sword, and put your will to
the max. While sliding on the two plates, do the max-move to the right.
Press left when you're flying back, and keep pressing left. You'll warp
to the cave where you get the star.

Warp 3- In the woods west of Wendel, there is one screen where a road
runs west to south and another road runs west to east on top of it. On
the bottom road, face west. Equip any ax and go to the western limit of
the screen. Make sure your limit gage is NOT full and attack to the
left, at the same time moving to the left screen. You'll warp to the
snowy fields.

Warp 4/5- In the last dungeon, there is a long zig-zag road. On the top
screen, stand on the farthest place you can go without entering the
forest-like place. Repeat the following until you go over the top of
the screen and warp to the fire cave. 1. press up 2. press "select"
while you're moving one step. (do this quickly) 3. save, reset Use this
method in the entrance to snowy fields and you don't have to get off
the Chocobo. (You can even enter the cave with the Chocobo)

This game has got to be one of the best games for the Nintendo Gameboy. I have 
4 gaming systems with me. A PC, the Gameboy, Super Nintendo (SNES), and the 
Sony Playstation (PSX). My favorite RPG for PC is Diablo (for me, this game is 
a RPG). For Gameboy, this one. For the Super Nintendo, Chrono Trigger. For the 
Playstation, Chrono Cross. 

This game was the FIRST RPG I’ve played and this game is the reason why I love 
RPG games the most (it doesn’t matter what console as long as it is good and 
well worth the money). This is also the game that introduced me to the 
HP/MP/EXP/character stats system. I think I will be able to accomplish this 
far earlier that the time I spent with my other guides for console games. Now, 
I can type and play at the same time. 

On to the game. The Tree of Mana sits on top of the clouds at Mount Illusia. 
It is foretold that this tree gives immense power to anyone who touches it. 
Once, Vandole tried to use this power for evil. Although they did get their 
hands on the Tree, the Gemma Knights were able to abolish them. The Gemma 
Knights are the protectors of the Mana Tree and the Mana Family as well as for 
the whole world. Now, a new empire sets it goal at getting the power of the 
Mana Tree. Again, to be used for evil purposes. It’s up to our Hero to fight 
to protect the Mana Tree and the World.

--------------
C. GAME BASICS
--------------

1. Moving About
---------------

Basically, you can move around with the directional pad. You cannot 
walkthrough walls, mountains, walk on water (you’ll be able to navigate the 
waters in the later parts of the game).

On the field or inside dungeons, you’ll see different kinds of enemies roaming 
around. If you touch one of these, you will receive damage at once. There are 
various ways of getting through enemies. First, just slash it will your weapon 
(although some enemies are not affected with certain types of weapons). 
Second, just go around it to prevent damage and save time. Lastly, just push 
them. You will be able to push an enemy, only if your level is higher than 
that monster (you can’t see the level of the enemy though).  

In the world map, you’ll also see some towns with people in it. You can talk 
to them for information regarding where to go next. Or just simple say hello 
to each other. 

Basically that’s all you have to do in the game besides attacking. Try to go 
with the flow of the story. It will excite you at the same time, you will be 
able to finish the game.

2. Saving and Loading your game
-------------------------------

The GamePak (Gameboy Cartridge) of Final Fantasy Adventure has 2 Slots. You 
can save 1 Game for every slot. Note that, both saves can be from the same 
game or from 2 distinct games. 

For loading games, you can only do that at the main menu by selecting the 
continue option. There is no Load command in the in-game menus. So, you’ll 
have to reset. Press the A, B, Select, and Start buttons at the same time. 
Note that doing this won’t save your game. 

3. Attacking and Battle System
------------------------------

Attacking in Final Fantasy Adventure is pretty basic. Go to an enemy within 
range of your weapon and then press the A button. Your character will attack 
using your weapon. If it hits the enemy, it’s HP will go down (the HP of the 
enemy cannot be seen). If the enemy’s HP reaches 0, it will die and will 
disappear from your sight. 

If ever your HP reaches 0, the Game will be over. And remember, once you’re in 
a new area, expect tougher enemies!

4. Magic System (Magic List)
----------------------------

There are only 8 Magic abilities for Final Fantasy Adventure. Here they are:

Cure  = Restores your character’s HP (2 MP)
Heal  = Remove any Status Ailment (except Moog) (1 MP)
Slep  = It lull’s enemies within the area into sleep (some are impervious
        to this magic spell (1 MP)
Mute  = This will disable the casting abilities of your enemy. Some cannot
        Be inflicted with this Magic Spell (1 MP)
Fire  = Throw a small fireball to the nearest enemy. This fireball will 
        Automatically chase your enemy even outside the screen area of the 
        Gameboy. (1 MP)
Ice   = Throws a small IceBerg on your enemies. Some enemies turn into 
        Snowmen after being hit by the IceBerg. You can then push them to
        Activate floor switches. IceBerg can be controlled by using the 
        Directional pad. If you accidentally hit a wall, the IceBerg will  
        Disappear. (2 MP)
Lit   = Throws a Lightning Bolt straight to the enemies in front of you.
        (2 MP)
Nuke  = Strongest Magic Attack. Hurls a ball of Nuclear Energy at your
        Enemies. It travels in a straight line only though. (3 MP)

Certain types of Magic do not affect some enemies. Example, fire-based enemies 
are not harmed by your Fire Spell. Some enemies also have a very high Magic 
Rating and cannot be inflicted with the Slep and Mute Spell. 

To acquire Magic spells, most of them can be read from Magic Books and then 
learned by your character. The Nuke Magic, can be obtained by beating Death.

To use a Magic spell, you MUST equip it first. Press the Start button and 
choose the Magic option. Now, select the magic you want to equip. You can now 
press the B button to execute the magic spell. Take note always of your 
available MP. If it reaches 0, you cannot use any magic anymore. 

The power of the Magic Spell also depends on your Will. If the Will Bar below 
the screen is full, you can unleash the strongest effect/damage of your magic 
spell.

5. Items 
--------

Items are very important in the game. Especially the Keys. To be able to use 
an item, you MUST equip it first by selecting it in the Item Sub-Menu. Then 
use it by using the B button. Some items, like the key, are used 
automatically.

Each of your items has a maximum quantity. Example, Pure Item is MAXed out at 
3. You can have 16 different items in your inventory. You can have 3 Pure 
Items with 3 quantities each. If you use it up, it will disappear from your 
inventory (of course!). 

You can acquire items, from Item Shops, spoils from enemies, chest and others 
are acquired automatically. 

6. Equipments
-------------

Equipments play a very important role as to how your character will fare with 
the enemies in the game. Having weak weapons will give you a long time to 
defeat an enemy. The same goes for the armors, helmets and Shields. The weaker 
they are, the bigger the damage you get. So, make it a basic rule that, you 
acquire every new equipment from shops if you reach a new town.

Another note on Shields. If your character’s Level is high enough. Let’s say 
about 70. You can push the pathetic enemies out of your way. If you are weak, 
you’ll get damage.

7. Non-Playable Characters (NPCs)
---------------------------------

In Final Fantasy Adventure, you also have other characters that can help you 
in your journey. Although, they are very helpful, you cannot control them. 
They have a quite stupid AI. They attack walls and trees, and even thin air 
for crying out loud. There is a concept here which I like most about the NPCs. 
It is your ability to ASK. If you ASK your NPCs, they will do their special 
abilities. Here are the infos about the NPCs in the game. Take note that if a 
NPC kills an enemy, its experience points will still be added to you. 

HEROINE
-------
Attack: None
You’ll meet her near Topple in the beginning of the game. She is a mysterious 
girl with mysterious powers. You’ll eventually know who she really is and what 
her destiny is. 

ASK: If you ASK her, she will slowly regenerate your HPs.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
--------------
Attack: Fireball
You’ll meet him inside the Cave of Marsh. He will immediately offer his help 
in finding the Mirror that can help you find the Girl (Heroine).

ASK: If you ASK him, he will teach you how to use the item, Mattock

WATTS
-----
Attack: Axe
He’s a member of the Tribe of Dwarves. He will join you in finding the Silver 
to be able to enter Gaia. 

ASK: If you ASK him, he will let you shop for Items. 

BOGARD
------
Attack: Sword
The Old, but still powerful, Gemma Knight will help you save the girl at the 
Airship. 

ASK: If you ASK him, he will teach you how to use MAX attacks. 

CHOCOBO
-------
Attack: None
You can find its Egg near Menos. It will think that you are its parents and 
will join you.

ASK: If you ASK the chocobo, it will give you a ride on its back. During
     this time, any enemy cannot harm you. Later, Chocobo will be 
     able to navigate the waters.

AMANDA
------
Attack: Dagger
You’ll meet her at the beginning of the Game but she won’t join you yet. 
Later, you’ll meet her again at the Cave of Medusa to find the Tears of Medusa 
to free Lester from the spell of Davias. 

ASK: If you ASK her, he will heal you of Petrify (Ston) condition. 

LESTER
------
Attack: Arrows
He is the brother of amanda. You will see him in the form of a parrot inside 
Davias Mansion. He will join you upon breaking the spell which is upon him. 

ASK: If you ASK him, he’ll change the background music (pretty useless)

MARCIE
------
Attack: Laser Beams
Marcie is a robot built by Dr. Bowow. Marcie lived in the Dime Tower ever 
since. 

ASK: If you ASK Marcie, your MP will be restored to its full.

8. Leveling Up
--------------

The level up system here is quite different. You can create your own type of 
character with level ups. You can create a very powerful character in terms of 
physical attacks. You can also create a very powerful magician with nasty 
magic attacks. 

When your character levels up, after gaining a specific amount of Experience, 
you must choose from 4 types. 

Power - This will increase the Power rating of your character. This will
        make and battle with monsters easier.

Stamina - This level up concentrates on your defense. You can now have less
          damage from enemy attacks. And you’ll have a big HP boost.

Wisdom - This focuses on the Magic ratings of your characters. This level up
         Will give you additional MP plus additional damage caused by your
         Magic attacks to your enemies. 

Will - Leveling up your Will, lessens the time that your Will Bar fills up.

9. MAX Attacks
--------------

When your Will Bar, at the bottom of the screen, fills up, you can use your 
weapons’ MAX Attack. Here’s what will happen to your weapons during a MAX 
Attack: (Note that MAX attacks increase the amount of damage you inflict on 
your enemies)

Sword - There are 2 types of MAX attack for the sword.
        1. Charge Attack - Press the A Button + Directional pad. Your 
                character will charge pointing to the direction depending
                on what direction you pushed in the Directional pad.
        2. Spin Attack - Press and hold the A button. This will make your
                character spin his sword. During the spinning of your
                character, you can move him around by pressing the 
                directional pad.

Axe - At MAX, your character will throw the Axe in front of him. Doing this,
      , the thrown Axe can still chop down trees. 

Chain - At MAX, the chain will be longer than usual. This will enable you to 
        reach poles which you cannot reach during normal chain attacks.

Spear - At MAX, the Spear will be thrown in the direction your pushed on the
        directional pad.

Sickle - At MAX, the area of the spin of the Sickle will become wider. 
         You can still cut off Herbs. 

Morning Star - At MAX, the length of the Morning Star will be much more 
               Longer than normal.

------------------
D. CHARACTER STATS
------------------

The Character Stat of your Character determines how your characters fare with 
the enemies around him. The higher his stat, the higher is his chance of 
beating stronger opponents. Here are the different characters stats and their 
explanations:

HP = Hit Points. This is the total amount of damage your character can 
     endure. If it reaches 0, your character will be dead. 
MP = Magic Points. This determines the total number of Magic you can use. 
     Take note also that not all magic abilities need 1 MP, some needs more.
E = Experience. The total experience your character gained from fighting 
    enemies. After reaching a certain amount of Experience, your character’s
    stats will go up. 
AP = The total attack power. This determines how strong your character is at
     beating opponents. The higher this stat is, the easier the enemies can
     be beaten.
DP = The total defense power. This stat determines how your character 
     endures magic and physical attacks. The higher the DP is, the lesser
     the HP loss.
Stamn = This is just like the DP. 
Power = This is just like the AP.
Wisdm = This will determine how strong your magic attacks will be. This also
        affects your total MP.
Will = this determines how fast your Will Power Bar fills up.

--------------------
E. STATUS CONDITIONS
--------------------

The status conditions mainly reflect the status of your character in the 
battlefield. Some conditions affect how your character attacks or defends. 
Sometimes, conditions affect the stats of your character. Here are the 
different status conditions with their explanation and Cure.

POIS
----
Poisoned Status. The HP of your character will slowly deplete. To cure it, use 
the item “Pure”, or use the Magic “Heal”. 

MOOG
----
Moogle Condition. Your DP will drop to 0 therefore, even the weakest enemies 
will deal quite a big damage to you. You’ll turn into an image of the moogle 
in this condition. There is no known item that can cure it. Although there is 
a moogle item, you can’t use it during Moog. There 2 known ways to cure it. 
First, just let time pass by. Second, ASK your chocobo.

STON
----
Stone Condition. Your character will be petrified and cannot move. This makes 
you very vulnerable to enemy attacks. In the contrary, you can still attack in 
place. To cure it, use the item “Soft” or use the magic “Heal”. You can also 
ASK Amanda to cure it for you. 

DARK
----
Darkness Condition. During this time, your screen will be dark and you can 
barely see the field/room. You can also see the enemies but it’s really 
confusing. To cure it, use the item “Eyedrop”, or use the Magic “Heal”.

=========
BEGINNING
=========

After the rolling of the Prologue, it’s time to name our Hero. There isn’t any 
default name given, so you can choose whatever name you like. For the sake of 
the walkthrough, let’s name it Sumo, just like what’s in the Manual. After 
that, name the Heroine of the game. For the sake of the walkthrough, let’s use 
the name Fuji that is also used in the manual. After naming both of them, 
you’ll be taken into an arena. You’ll start off at Level 1 with 19 HPs, 6 MPs, 
and 50 GP (monetary unit). And then, you will have to beat the Jackal. 

BOSS: JACKAL
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         0
GP:                 0
Attacks:            none!
Preferred Weapon:   Sword (no choice!)

This Boss has a very low intelligence. It doesn’t attack you. It will just 
walk in a ‘W’ like pattern. From where you are standing, you’re safe. Press

section: the Attack button and you’ll kill it with 8 slashes.
text:
the Attack button and you’ll kill it with 8 slashes. 
#############################################################################

After the battle with the Jackal, you’ll see a sad scene where Willy, Sumo’s 
friend, dies after a fight with the monster. For his last words, he will tell 
you that the Gemma Knights must know what happened. Sumo will be confused. He 
will then tell you to go to Bogard at the Falls. Then, Willy will pass away. 
Head up, through the door, to the area to the north. Here, you’ll see Amanda 
who wants to go home and see her little brother. The Man will talk about the 
entrance of the monsters. After talking to them, head right to the next 
screen. In here, use the ladder. In this next screen, continue heading left 
until you meet another Jackal. Use the same strategy against it. After the 
fight, notice that the entrance of the monster is open. Head there are you’ll 
find yourself outside the premises of the castle. After regaining control of 
Sumo, head left to the next area. Here, you’ll see Julius and Dark Lord 
talking about how to go up the falls and reach the Tree of Mana. Then Julius 
will tell Dark Lord that a girl has the key. After that, Julius will 
disappear. Dark Lord now notices you. You’ll then automatically run up to a 
cliff. Here, Dark Lord will push you down! (Ahhh! How did Sumo survive?) After 
falling, you’ll regain control of Sumo again, but now you are in the World 
Map. 

=====
WORLD
=====

For a World Map, I created a quick reference at the maps section. Check it 
out. You can also check it out if you get lost. Back to the walkthrough. From 
your starting point, head right to the next screen. After that, head right 
again to the next screen. From here, go south. After that, so south once more. 
In this area, the only way is to the right. So, go right to the next area. 
From here, go right again. In this area, you’ll see a girl and a wounded boy 
seeking for help. Defeat ALL monsters in this screen only. After defeating 
every monster (the clue is that there will be no more music), talk to the 
wounded boy. His name is Hasim. He will also tell you to take the girl with 
you to Bogard (the same man Willy spoke of). After that, Hasim will pass away. 
You will then offer the girl to come with you to see Bogard. The girl will 
join you. She is the Heroine in the game, Fuji. At this point, you finally 
have an NPC (non-playable character) with you. You can now ask her if your HP 
is low and she will gradually heal you. After taking her along, go back to the 
screen to the left. After that, go up to the screen to the north. Here, you’ll 
find the entrance to the Town of Topple which is to the north. If you got lost 
somehow, the entrance to Topple is located on coordinates 8I in my world map 
at the Maps section. 

======
TOPPLE
======

This is quite a small village. Upon entering the Village, you’ll see the Inn 
right away. You can rest here for 10GP. Afterwards, head next screen to the 
left. Then, go north to another screen. You’ll find the Item and Weapon Shops 
here. You can buy a more powerful helmet here. It costs 140 GPs. If you don’t 
have enough, I suggest that you leave the town first, beat some enemies, and 
come back with 140 GPs. After buying the helmet, sell your Bronze ones. After 
that, go inside the Item Shop and buy 2 Sets of Keys (each set contains 4) for 
30 GPs. After doing these, leave Topple.

=====
WORLD
=====

From here, we will now go to Bogard. First, go right to the next screen. Then, 
to the screen to the right. Then, go south. Then, go right. After that, go up. 
Then, left. Here, cross the bridge and head left. Then, go up. Cross again 
another bridge then head left. Here, cross the bridge and climb the vine to 
the north. Here, there are 2 ladders. Climb the left one and head left to the 
next screen. Here, there are 3 vines wherein you can’t reach the leftmost one. 
Climb UP the nearest vine to reach the north screen. Here, just go around the 
vines to reach the vine on the lower left of the Screen then climb down it. 
You’ll be in a familiar screen. From here, head left to the next screen. Then, 
continue up the vine until you reach a small house. Enter it. In case you are 
lost, refer to the map. The house is in coordinates 5G.

==============
BOGARD’S HOUSE
==============
Item:
  Mattock

Upon entering, you’ll see an old man to the left. If you talk to him, he will 
just walk away from you. But on the third time, he will notice the pendant of 
Fuji. Then, he will finally reveal himself as Bogard. He will talk about what 
happened years ago when a woman, who wore the pendant, gave the Gemma knights 
hope and was finally able to beat Vandole. After that, he will tell you go get 
the Mattock in the north room. After that, he will tell you that you must use 
the mattock in the caves to the east and meet a man named Cibba at the town of 
Wendel. When the door opens, go in and take the Mattock. Now, leave Bogard’s 
house by going 2 screens to the south. 

=====
WORLD 
=====

From Bogard’s house, move one screen to the south. Then, one screen to the 
right. Then, one screen north. Here, go around and then south one screen. 
Then, right 2 screens. Here, climb down the vine and enter the cave. If you 
got lost somehow, check the coordinates 6J on the map.

=============================
CAVE (East of Bogard’s House)
=============================

upon entering, equip the Mattock that Bogard gave you. Then, stand in front of 
the Rocks that block the path to the south. Press the B Button to remove them. 
Go south to the next screen. Then go south once more. Here, use the ladders at 
the bottom right of the screen to exit to the world map. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Once in the world map, head left two screens. Then, south one screen. And 
then, right one screen. Here, you’ll find a general store. You can buy a 
Battle Axe for 150 GPs. If you don’t have enough GP, kill enemies and then 
come back and buy it. I really advise it. After buying the axe, leave the 
shop. Outside the shop, head left one screen. You’ll now be in the Marshes 
area.

===============
WORLD (Marshes)
===============

You’ll find new enemies here. Now, head south two screens. And then, head left 
three screens. You’ll arrive at the entrance of Kett’s, and then enter it. If 
you got lost somehow, check coordinates 10K at the World Map in my map 
section. 

======
KETT’S 
======
Magic:
  Cure

Inside, when you talk to the man, he will tell you that you must take the 
western room because the other rooms are occupied and that the door behind him 
is for Mr. Lee. After talking to the man, you can go up to the room on the 
north and talk to people here. After you talked to them, or not, from the 
screen where the man you first talked to, head west one screen. Then north one 
screen. Here, sleep on the bed by walking to it. You’ll automatically sleep. 
During the night, you’ll have a short scene with Fuji. She will now let you 
read the Magic book of Cure! Then you’ll automatically learn your first magic, 
Cure! :) After receiving the magic, you’ll continue to sleep. During the 
night, you’ll notice someone talks about his/her new victim. When you finally 
wake up, Fuji is gone! She was kidnapped! Now, talk to the man guarding the 
door to Mr. Lee. He will deny any knowledge about Fuji. Now, leave Kett’s.

===============
WORLD (Marshes)
===============
Item:
  Bronze Key

From the entrance of Kett’s, go right 3 screens. Then, go south. You’ll see 
Crocs here. If you talked to the person at Kett’s (in the north room), this is 
the Lizardmen he is talking about. Now, defeat ALL of the Lizardmen in this 
screen. After doing that, a chest will appear in the middle. Examine it and 
you’ll get the Bronze Key. Now, head back north 1 screen. You’ll see a door. 
Equip your Bronze Key and go in the door. 

=============
CAVE OF MARSH
=============
Item:
  Mirror
Equipment:
  Sickle
  Iron Shield
Magic:
  Fire

Upon entering, you’ll see a man. Talk to him and he will tell you that a lot 
of girls disappeared at Kett’s. He will offer you his help. Accept his help. 
After joining, head north first. And then, to the left one screen. Here, step 
on the switch at the bottom of the screen. A ladder leading down will show up 
at the top left of the screen. Go down the ladder. In this new screen, you’ll 
see the door where you came in and a door at the bottom. Now, move one screen 
to the right. Climb down the vine to be able to reach the bottom door in the 
screen to the left. Go in. Here, go right one screen. Now, if you strike the 
bottom center wall, you’ll here a cranking sound. Use your mattock to destroy 
the wall and reveal a new path. Now, go down south to the next screen. In 
here, get the chest that you see in the middle of the screen. You’ll receive 
the Sickle. You can go back as the floor will pull you back in. So, equip the 
sickle and hack away the herbs. You can now leave the room. Now, return back 
to the first room (where you first saw the man). Now, head south one screen. 
Here, the left wall can be destroyed. Use your mattock to destroy it then head 
left one screen. Here, there is a door to the north. Use a key (if you have at 
least 4 of them) and enter the door. You’ll see a chest in the middle. Push 
the chest into the switch on the lower left. A ladder going down will appear 
at the upper right. Climb that ladder. You’ll reach a small pond. If you walk 
below it, your HP and MP will be restored completely. Let’s call it the 
Recovery Pond. Now, head back up the ladder and then move one screen to the 
south. And then, head left two screens. From here, go up one screen. You’ll 
see a door to the right which is locked. Use your key and then enter it. 
Inside, you’ll be automatically locked in. Defeat all enemies on the screen 
and a chest will appear. It contains an Iron Shield. After getting the shield, 
go back one screen and then go up one screen. In here, go right one screen. 
You’ll see a big rock at the upper right corner. Use your mattock to destroy 
it and it will reveal a ladder leading down. Here, go south one screen (go 
around the vines). And then, go left one screen and enter the doorway that you 
will see. In this new area, head left one screen then south one screen. You’ll 
see a locked door to the right. Use the key and enter that door. Here you’ll 
see a very simple puzzle. Let’s call those clear square floors as “panels” for 
the sake of this walkthrough. Now, walk on the topmost panel to reach the 
upper switch. Now, use your mattock to break the rocks. After that, break the 
lower set of rocks to reach the lower floor switch. Upon switching both floor 
switches, a ladder leading down will appear on the lower right corner. Go down 
the ladder. Now, prepare yourself for a REAL boss. After preparation, head 
right to the next screen. You’ll meet...

BOSS: 2-HEADED DRAGON
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         10
GP:                 95
Attacks:            Fireballs
Preferred Weapon:   Sickle

This battle will be hard, if you don’t know what to do. The only way to damage 
it is to hit it in the head. The best strategy here is to use the sickle and 
always stay below the hydra. Doing this, when the hydra comes forward, you can 
hit it with the sickle away from the path of the fireballs. After a few hits, 
it will go down. 

If you are cornered, and you have the Iron Shield, you can just stand in front 
of the fireballs (facing their direction) and the shield will negate it. In 
simpler terms, you can block the fireballs. Of course, you can’t block the 
head of the Dragon when it comes near you.
#############################################################################

After the fight, you’ll see 2 chests appear in the middle. The first chest 
contains your second magic, Fire. After getting the chest, hack it away and 
get the second chest for the Mirror. The man will tell you to show it to the 
guy at Kett’s. After that, the man will leave and you’ll be taken 
automatically to the world map. Head to Kett’s right away. Make sure to 
prepare your character again. 

======
KETT’S
======
Equipment:
  Chain Flail
Magic:
  Sleep

Now, Equip your mirror. It’s in the items inventory. And then, talk to the 
man. It will go berserk and will change into a wolf man. Just use your sickle 
to push it away from you at the same time damaging it. I’d like to point out 
that this enemy is not a boss (you’ll know why later). After beating this 
enemy, you can now enter the room to the right. So, go right two screens. 
Then, go up one screen. And then, to the left one screen. In this room, use 
the ladder that is going up. Now, go south one screen. Here, you’ll see 6 
blocks. If you attack the right wall, you’ll hear a clink. Blast that wall 
with your Mattock. After blasting away the wall, head right to the next 
screen. And then, go up one screen. And then, to the right one screen and to 
the south two screens. Here, go left one screen. In this room, break the jar 
to reach the switch in the middle. Step on it and a ladder leading down will 
appear in the lower right. Go down that ladder. Here, go around the spikes and 
go right one screen. Next, go up one screen. Here, use a key to open the north 
door and go through it. Now, you’ll see a chest. Get it for the Chain Flail! 
You will be trapped, but to no avail, use your new Chain Flail on the pole to 
the right. You’ll be able to get out. Now, go around and step on the switch to 
remove the block. Go back to where you broke the Jar in order to step on the 
middle switch. Now, use the Ladder Going up on the upper right corner of the 
room. Now, go left and use your Chain Flail to cross the gap. Move on to the 
left and climb down the ladder at the end. And then, head left one screen and 
then up one screen. Here, there’s a gap on the floor. First of all, you MUST 
wait until your will power to fill up. Then, use the chain on the pole on the 
other side. You’ll never reach it when using normal chain attacks. If you fell 
down the gap, head north and climb the ladder on the upper right. In the next 
area, head down south. You’ll be in the room where the gap is. From here, head 
right two screens and then up one screen. Next, left one screen. Here, push 
the chest onto the switch. A ladder will appear on the upper right. Use the 
ladder to go down. Here, use a Mattock and destroy the jar on the lower right. 
Go down the newly revealed ladder. Here, go around the fence and to the right 
one screen. Here, use a Key to open the south door then go in. There are 
caskets here. Go to the 2nd from the right casket on the lowest row. You’ll 
now get Fuji back. Now, head all the way back to the very beginning (where you 
showed the mirror to the man who turned into a monster).

section: head of the Dragon when it comes near you.
text:
If, however, you got lost, here’s the instruction on how to get back. From the 
caskets, head up one room then left one room. Use the ladder. In the new room, 
use the top right ladder. And then, one to the right, one down, one to the 
left, and then one down again. Here, use the ladder. Next, go right and cross 
the gap. Climb down the ladders at the end. Next, go right one screen and then 
go north 2 screens. And then, one screen to the left then one screen to the 
south. After that, head left one screen then north one screen. Use the ladder 
here. Next, walk around the fence and go right one screen. Now, head south one 
screen then left one screen. Here, prepare your character for a boss battle. 
After preparing, head to the next screen to the left. You’ll now fight Mr. 
Lee.

BOSS: MR. LEE

#############################################################################
EXP gained:         21
GP:                 11
Attacks:            Bats
Preferred Weapon:   Chain
Spoils:             Magic Book of Sleep (Slep Magic)

This battle isn’t hard at all, especially with the Chain flail at your 
disposal. You notice that the Vampire (Mr. Lee), will move to 4 locations on 
the screen. Check the diagram below (He’ll move to one of those check marks):

 -------
|   x   |
|x     x|
|   x   |
 -------

His attacks are plain and simple. Once he stops moving, he’ll open his cape 
and bats will come right after you. You can block the bats with your shield 
though. 

To attack him, target his body not his wings :) If you’re far enough from him, 
you can also attack the bats at the same time damaging him. Trust me, he’s

easy.
#############################################################################

After beating Mr. Lee and gaining the Magic Book of Sleep, after a very short 
conversation between Fuji and Sumo, you’ll be taken automatically outside of 
Kett’s. It’s now time to head to Wendel.

=====
WORLD
=====

From Kett’s, head right 3 screens and then south one screen. You’ll be at the 
LizardMen’s Nest. Now, head left one screen. Equip your Sickle and hack away 
the Herbs. After that, head south one screen. Next, head left one screen and 
then north one screen. Climb up the ladder and use your Chain to cross the 
Gap. Now head south one screen. You’ll notice that you are now in the other 
side of the river. Now, head right one screen. Then, south two screens. 
Finally, head right one screen. Enter the town of Wendel, which is to the 
north.

======
WENDEL
======
Magic:
  Heal

Map:
     ---
    | 3 |
 --- --- ---
| 2 |   |   |
 --- --- ---
| 1 | E |   |
 --- --- ---

Legend:
E = Entrance, Inn
1 = Item Shop
2 = Weapon Shop
3 = Cibba’s Place

In Wendel, you might want to upgrade your equipments here if you don’t have a 
complete Iron Set (helmet, armor, shield). You can also buy Mattocks and Keys 
from the item shop. After that, head to Cibba’s place. In here, just continue 
moving north until you see Cibba. After you meet him, an automatic scene will 
take place. Cibba will show something to you. You’ll see the real mother of 
Fuji. Also, you’ll now know that Fuji is a member of the Mana Family. Her 
mother sealed the waterfalls that lead to the Mana Tree with the pendant Fuji 
is wearing. After that, something wrong will happen. The man who helped you 
before will come in and tells you that Glaive is attacking! Then, you’ll be 
taken automatically just outside Cibba’s place. If you talk to the wounded 
man, he’ll tell you that the man who just passed by attacked him. Quickly, 
head outside of Wendel. Don’t worry about the enemies, they’re pathetic. 
Outside, you’ll see a horrible sight. The man who helped you out in the Cave 
of Marsh turns out to be Julius himself. He saw what happened inside and 
finally kidnapped Fuji. You can’t do anything as he is very strong. He’ll beat 
you up and then he’ll leave. Then, you’ll wake up at Cibba’s Room. Cibba will 
tell you that Julius took her to his Airship to the west. Then, he’ll give you 
the Magic Book of Heal. After that, leave Wendel right away.

=====
WORLD
=====

From the gate, head south one screen. Next, head left one screen then south 
one screen. After that, head left once more. Here, beat the enemies. You have 
to go north. So, equip your axe and hack away the leftmost tree. Then, go 
north one screen. And then, to the left two screens. Here, equip your chain 
and use it on the pole on the lower left. After that, head south one screen. 
Here, go right one screen and then to the south one screen. Here, go inside 
the hut. It is a General Store. Buy the Oil here for 500 GP. If you don’t have 
that much yet, go out and kill as many enemies to reach 500 GP. After buying 
the Oil, leave the store. From the store, head North one screen. Here, use 
your chain again to grab that pole. Next, go north two screens. In here, equip 
your axe and hack the trees to the north. Take a look at the diagram:

After hacking the trees. Head to the left one screen. Now, go inside the cave. 

===========
SILVER MINE
===========
Items:
  Silver

Upon entrance, you’ll see a small cart to the left. First, equip the Oil that 
you bought a while ago. Now, follow my instructions carefully. This might get 
very confusing and even frustrating. If you’re ready, equip your Sickle and go 
to the cart. It will then move along the tracks automatically. 

After boarding the cart, it will go left two screens. Here, there’s a switch, 
but don’t do anything to it. The cart will then continue to the left for 
another two screen. And then, it’ll go down south one screen. Now, Press and 
Hold Up + Right on the Directional Pad. The cart will now go one screen to the 
right. As the screen, changes, press the Attack button like crazy! This will 
enable you to activate the switch. After successfully activating the switch, 
press and hold Down + Right on the directional pad. The cart will now go south 
one screen. Like before, just as the screen changes, press the Attack button 
like crazy while holding the Down+Right on the Directional Pad. This will 
activate another switch. After successfully activating the switch, the cart 
will go left two screens. It will hit a rock and you’ll fall down a dark hole. 
If you however, missed the switches, don’t worry, the cart will go back to 
that place again. 

After falling down the hole, you’ll see Watts. He’ll join you as an NPC to 
guide you through the cave. Remember that when you’re low on supplies, you can 
ASK Watts and he’ll let you shop for items.

Let’s move on. From where you saw Watts, head north one screen, and then to 
the right one screen. In here, there are passages to the right (a breakable 
wall) and to the south. Let’s head south first.

Use your Mattock to break the rocks then move on south to the next screen. 
Here’s you’ll see a recovery spring. After healing, head back to the north one 
screen and then, break the wall to the right and go right one screen. Here, 
there are 2 jars and slippery floors. Break the right jar, step on the switch 
and slide to the right towards the ladder leading down. Here, go left two 
screens. And then, go up the entrance. In this new area, head left one screen. 
And then, north one screen. Use the ladder leading up. In this area, head one 
screen to the left. Now, use the ladder leading down. Now, you’ll see a ladder 
to the right leading down. Prepare your character first for a boss fight.

BOSS: MEGAPEDE
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         48
GP:                 161
Attacks:            Surprise!
Preferred Weapon:   Chain

This battle will be fairly easy. Just remember the pattern it does. It will 
move in a S formation. Always remember that it can only be damaged by hitting 
it’s head. Any attack to the body is null. He has only one attack (which I 
think is intentionally created by Square). After you beat him, as with most of 
the bosses, it’s body will explode. The explosion can hurt your character. The 
Magapede, due to its size, especially its length, will scatter the explosion 
in a very wide area so, right after you hear the explosion of the monster, 
quickly move away from it! Take note that the head will follow you after you

kill it :)
#############################################################################

After beating the Megapede, get the Silver from the chest. Then, you’ll be 
automatically taken outside the Mine. Here, Watts will take care of the 
Silver. He’ll tell you that he will forge some armors and sword using the 
Silver so that you can equip it and be able to enter Gaia. Watts will now exit 
to the right. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Now, equip your Battle Axe again and then go right one screen. Hack away the 
trees again and then go south two screen. Next, go south one screen (do not 
use your chain to go to the other side). Here, you’ll see the entrance to the 
Dwarf Cave. Enter it.

==========
DWARF CAVE
==========

In here, you’ll see quite a number of dwarves. So where’s Watts? From the 
entrance, go south one screen. Watts will be there sitting on a chair. Talk to 
him. He will sell you an Armor, Shield and the Sword made from the Silver. 
After buying and equipping, head north one screen and use the ladder to exit 
the Dwarf Cave.

=====
WORLD
=====

From the Dwarf Cave, head north two screens. Next, head left one screen and 
then to the north, one screen. You’ll see a cave which looks like a big mouth 
with 2 eyes. Enter it now. Remember that you MUST equip any Silver equipment 
in order to enter Gaia. One Silver Equipment is enough. 

====
GAIA
====

Upon entrance, head left one screen and then south one screen. As you go 
south, you’ll step on an invisible switch that closes the south door. Here’s 
what you must do. Go south to the door. It will be closed right? Now, go north 
slowly and you’ll be able to touch the switch once again which opens the door. 
Once the door is open, head south one screen. Here, use the ladder to exit to 
the world map. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Upon leaving Gaia, Bogard will come in and joins you as a NPC. If you ask him, 
he’ll just tell you how to use the MAX Attack. Now, go south one screen. Here, 
equip your axe. Destroy the trees. Follow the diagram.
