   ttt   t
ttttttt tt

After cutting the trees, head left one screen. Then, go north two screens. 
Here, you’ll find a small house. It’s an Inn. After resting, if necessary, 
equip your Axe and hack the trees to the left and go left to the next screen. 
Here, cross the wooden bridge and then, go left one screen. Next, go north one 
screen. Here, cross a wooden bridge again and then enter the house. This is a 
general store. You can buy the Silver Helmet here. After buying it, leave the 
shop. From the shop, head right two screens. And then, go up one screen. Equip 
your Axe and hack the trees to the right. And then, go right one screen. Now, 
equip your Chain. Go to the edge and wait for the Will Bar to fill up. If it’s 
full, use it on the pole on the other side. Note that you can only reach it 
with a Maxed Chain. After successfully bringing yourself on the other side, go 
north one screen. And then, go right one screen. Here, use your chain on the 
pole on the top platform. After going up the platform, go left one screen. 
Here, go left. Go down the vines and you’ll notice 2 paths to the left. Take 
the lower left path. In here, cross a gap once more and then go south one 
screen. And then, go left one screen. Finally, continue moving north until you 
reach the Airship.

================
GLAIVE’S AIRSHIP
================

Upon entering, continue moving up the big chain to the next screen. Here, 
you’ll see 3 paths. Two to the north and one to the right. Use the upper left 
path to the next screen. Next, go left one screen. And then, go south one 
screen. Here, go inside the door that you’ll see. Inside, go left three 
screen. And then, go up one screen. Next, go right to the next screen. Climb 
the ladder here which is leading down. In this new area, go left one screen 
and then go south one screen. Here, kill all the werewolves on the left side 
first. After killing all of them, step on the switch on the upper right. This 
will open the fence on the left side. Now, step on the upper left switch. A 
ladder will appear. Use it to go down to the next area. Here, go left two 
screens. Now, equip a key and use it on the south door and then enter the 
room. You’ll see Fuji inside. Go to the fence and you’ll talk to her. You’ll 
hear that the Airship is ready to leave. You will now have a plan to save 
Fuji. The window. So, after talking to Fuji, leave the room. Before you leave, 
Bogard will stay behind to watch over Fuji while you find your way to the 
window outside.

Now, go all the way to the north until you enter the room with a bed. Use it 
to regain all your HPs and MPs. After that, go south one screen. And then, go 
right two screens. Use the ladder. You’ll be back to the place where you 
killed the werewolves. Now, go north one screen and then left one screen. Use 
the ladders here. When you reach the next area, go south one screen and then 
go left two screens. Next, go south one screen. And then, go left one screen. 
Here, use the ladders. When you reach the next area, go north two screens and 
then use the ladder that you’ll see. Next, go north and use the other set of 
ladders. You’ll now be back on the deck of the airship. Now, go right one 
screen. Here, you’ll see two paths to the north. Take the upper left path. 
Next, go left two screens. And then, go south one screen. Next, go right one 
screen. Beware of the werewolves here! Kill them all and then continue down 
the ladder to the next screen. Now, go all the way to the right and you’ll see 
Fuji on the window. But, Julius will come in and blasts you! You will try to 
hang on but to no avail, you will still fall down. 

=====
MENOS
=====

You’ll fall on one of the houses in Menos. Then, you’ll see that it is 
Amanda’s house. If you do not remember, Amanda was the girl you saw in the 
very beginning of the game (Right after Willy passed away). Then, you’ll see 
Amanda take away the pendant. When you wake up, Sumo will notice that the 
pendant is gone. When you regain control of Sumo, leave the house. There’s a 
stronger weapon here in Menos. From the house of Amanda, the Weapon Shop is to 
the left. If you want items, it is one screen to the right from Amanda’s 
House. After buying items and equipments, leave Menos.

=====
WORLD
=====

From Menos, go south two screen. Here, you can either cross the bridge to the 
right or go left to the other screen. Let’s get an important character first. 
So, cross the bridge to the right and go north one screen. Here, just go to 
the right one screen. Cross the bridge and go north two screens. Next, go left 
one screen and then north two screens. And then, go right one screen. You’ll 
notice that this is where you fell at the beginning of the game. Now, go south 
one screen and then one screen to the right. Here, equip your chain and cross 
the gap. Examine the egg and it will hatch. It’s a Chocobo! It will follow you 
because it thinks that you are its mother. You now have a New NPC, the 
Chocobo! If you ASK, it will give you a ride. You’ll be much faster and safer 
because enemies cannot harm you if you are on a chocobo.

Now, let’s head back to the first bridge you saw after leaving Menos. For 
directions, here it is: from the Chocobo’s place, use the chain to cross the 
gap. Go left to the next screen. Go up one screen, then left one screen, and 
then south two screens. Next, go right one screen and then to the south two 
screens. Now, go left one screen and then south one screen. Here, cross the 
bridge and go left one screen. If you go up, you’ll be back at Menos. In this 
new area, go left one screen. Next, go north two screens. And then, go left 
one screen, then north one screen. Enter the town of Jadd. Don’t worry about 
your chocobo it won’t run. 

====
JADD
====

Upon entering, you’ll notice that the whole town is quiet. It’s because a 
certain Davias rules the town. First of all, let’s head for the weapon shop as 
there are powerful versions of equipments here, the Gold Equipments. From the 
entrance, go north one screen. You’ll see the Weapon Shop beside the Inn. You 
can rest in the Inn if you want. After that, go to the Weapon Shop and buy 
Gold equipments. This will protect you from the enemies in this area. For the 
items, from the Weapon Shop, go right one screen. You’ll see the Item Shop 
Here. Now, if you talk to the kid, it will give you a hint on how to open the 
Cave of Oasis. You must give him Fangs though. You can get fangs from the 
Gecko’s living in the desert. It’s very rarely though, that they drop these 
item. If you got Fangs, and talked to him, he will say “Palms trees and an 8”. 
After buying and equipping your character, leave Jadd. 

=====
WORLD
=====

In the world map, talk to your Chocobo Immediately. If you did not talk to it, 
it will not join you again. So, choose to take your chocobo. Now, let’s head 
for the Cave of Oasis. From Jadd, go south one screen. And then, go right one 
screen. Then, go south two screens. You’ll see the Gecko here. If you beat it, 
you might be lucky enough to get a Fang. If you got one, bring it back to the 
kid near the Item Shop in Jadd. It will give you the clue to the Cave of 
Oasis. Let’s move on. From the place with the Gecko, go left one screen. And 
then go south one screen. Here’s another place with Geckos. Now, go right one 
screen. You see a lot of palms trees right? It’s because the cave of Oasis, 
also known as the Cave of Medusa. Now, let’s talk about the clue of the Kid. 
Palm trees and an 8. Hmm... There are 2 trees here. What should you do? It’s 
easy. Take a look at the diagram.

  xxxxx
  xTxTx
  xxxxx

The 2 Ts represent the 2 trees in the middle. The x’s is the pattern you 
should walk. See, it’s an 8. Walk around the trees making a pattern like an 
8,just as in the diagram. If done correctly, the Cave of Medusa will now open. 
So, go inside the Cave.

==============
CAVE OF MEDUSA
==============
Magic:
  Magic Book of Ice

Upon entering, you’ll see Amanda. Sumo will ask Amanda why she took the 
pendant. Amanda took it so that he could give it to Davias and free her 
brother from Davias’ Curse. And then, Amanda will now join you as a NPC. Now, 
head south one screen. In here, equip your Mattock and destroy the wall in the 
south wall. Then, go south one screen. And then, head left two screen then go 
south one screen. Next, head left two screens. Now, go up one screen. If you 
open the door to the left, you can see a recovery spring inside. After using 
it, if necessary, go back and go north two screen. Now, go left one screen and 
then go south one screen. You’ll get a Gold Armor. Now, go back up one screen 
and then one screen to the right. Here, continue moving by going up one 
screen. Here, equip your chain. Then, go to the slippery floor which is at the 
very bottom. You’ll be taken to the switch which will open the right door. 
Now, use your chain at the pole at once, then go right one screen through the 
newly opened door. Here, you’ll receive the Magic Book of Ice.

After receiving the Ice Magic, go left one screen. And then, go south four 
screens. Here, go right one screen. Equip your Mattock and destroy the wall to 
the north. Then, go up one screen. Here, you’ll see a snowman. Push the 
snowman by going behind it and pressing the directional pad. Push it to the 
north past the slippery floors. Now, push it to the switch on the upper left. 
Once there, the door to the north will open. If you somehow destroyed the 
Snowman, just leave the room and go back in. A new snowman should be there. 
After opening the door, go up one screen. Here, you’ll see another switch, but 
there are no snowmen around except for spiders. Now, use your newly gained Ice 
Magic on one of the spiders. It will turn into a snowman! Take note that YOU 
CAN CONTROL the ice as it travels! But you cannot stop it from moving. If it 
hits a wall it’s gone. Let’s continue. After turning one of the spiders into a 
snowman, push it to the switch. The north door will now open. So, go north one 
screen. Here, use the ladder.

In this new area, go north one screen. Then, use the ladder on top. Now, 
prepare your character for a boss! After preparing, go left one screen.

BOSS: MEDUSA 
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         92
GP:                 70
Attacks:            Snakes
Preferred Weapon:   Chain

This battle will be at an average difficulty. I recommend using the chain as 
it has a very long range and attack rate. To defeat Medusa, you have to hit 
her head as many times as you could. Amanda will also give you support by 
throwing daggers (not accurate though). She only has 1 attack. She will throw 
snakes at you! Try to avoid these as they can inflict the Ston status. Don’t 
worry though. If you got Stoned, just ask amanda and she’ll heal you. So, just 
try to be quick while avoiding the snakes and Medusa herself, then attack her 
head as fast as you can. 

Also, if you have the Gold shield equipped, it can block the snakes which

Medusa throws at you.
#############################################################################

After beating Medusa, she will not cry therefore you cannot get the Tears of 
Medusa to uncurse Amanda’s Brother. As you leave, Amanda will fell something. 
She was bitten by Medusa while you were fighting. Anyone who is bitten by 
Medusa will also turn into a Medusa. Amanda will turn into a Medusa anytime 
now. But before she loses her mind, she will tell you to get a tear from her, 
because she is now a Medusa and can uncurse her brother, and then kill her 
afterwards so that she can’t hurt people. When you regain control of Sumo, 
kill Amanda (you can’t move on to the story if you don’t do this). After 
killing her, go to her and you’ll get the Tears of Amanda. Then, you’ll 
automatically be taken outside to the world map. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Now, take your chocobo and head back to Jadd. For the directions, here it is. 
First go left one screen, then go north two screens, then go right one screen. 
Next, go north one screen, then go left one screen, and finally, go north one 
screen and enter the town of Jadd.

====
JADD
====

After the battle with Medusa, your HP and MP might be low. So, head to the Inn 
which is one screen to the north from the entrance. After healing yourself, go 
the BIG house on the upper leftmost part of Jadd. Enter the Mansion of Davias.

===============
DAVIAS’ MANSION
===============
Magic:
  Mute
Weapon:
  Were Axe

Inside, go up the set of ladders on the top right corner. Next, go left two 
screens. Now, you’ll see a parrot here. It is Amanda’s Brother. So, equip 
Amanda’s Tear and examine the parrot. Lester will now be freed from Davias’ 
Curse. He will now join you to avenge Amanda as a NPC. If you ask Lester, he 
will change the music for you. Let’s move on. Use the ladder which appeared.

In this new area, go right two screens. Here, equip your Mattock and then 
destroy the wall to the north. And then, go north two screens. And then, head 
left one screen then south one screen. Here, just step on the slippery panel 
in a counter clockwise direction and use the ladders. In this new area, go 
left four screens. At the end, you’ll see a lot of floor panels. The key here 
is to step on the panels in order. Here’s the diagram for you.

 43       Legend: the numbers are the order of the panels you should follow. 
5xx2
6xx1
 7 

Doing this, a ladder will appear and you can go to the next area. Now, in this 
new area, go up one screen and then go left one screen. Now, go ALL THE WAY 
SOUTH until you can’t go south anymore. You’ll also see a door to your right 
which doesn’t open. You must step on the switch to open the door. So, in 
short, use your Ice Magic on one of the enemies and push the snowman onto the 
switch. Once the door is open, go in. The door will automatically lock. Defeat 
all the enemies and you’ll get the Were Axe. Now, go left one screen. And 
then, go up two screens. Here, equip your Mattock and break the wall to the 
right. And then, go right one screen and then go south one screen. Here, use 
the ladder. Now, in this new area, go north one screen. Use the ladders that 
you’ll see here. Now, prepare your character again as a tough battle lies 
ahead of you.

BOSS: DAVIAS  
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         100
GP:                 103
Attacks:            FireBalls
Preferred Weapon:   Chain

He will be very hard if you don’t know what to do. First, I suggest you use 
the Chain Flail again. It has a very good range and you can hit Davias with 
ease. Be careful of his Fireballs at it will go STRAIGHT AT YOU so dodge them. 
Also, do not touch the fireball that are protecting Davias. These will give a 
lot of damage to you.

Tip: You can use your weapon to attack the Fireballs (excluding the fireballs 
around Davias)
#############################################################################

After beating him, you’ll find out that the pendant is no longer with him. 
Garuda flew together with the pendant to Glaive. Then, Davias will die. After 
that, you’ll be taken automatically to Jadd. Here, Lester will stay to play 
Requiem for his sister. You’ll now be heading for Glaive! Lester’s tune will 
remove the poison gas to the north (if you went there earlier). Before 
leaving, Lester will give you the Magic book of Mute. Now, heal your character 
at the Inn and then leave Jadd.

=====
WORLD
=====

Outside, get your chocobo. We’ll now be heading for Glaive! You can ride the 
chocobo to reach there fast or just walk there to gain experience. From the 
entrance of Jadd, go south one screen. And then, go right one screen then up 
one screen. Next, go right one screen. Next, go up two screens. And then, go 
right one screen. 

Next, go north two screens. Next, go right one screen. Here, climb up the 
ladder to the next screen. Here, you can go right one screen or climb down 2 
vines. First, go down the right most vine. At the very bottom, you’ll see a 
Magic Shop. Buy some if you want and then go back up the vines. Next, go left 
one screen. Here, go inside the Cave.

=================
CAVE OF MT. ROCKS
=================

Inside, go left one screen and then go north one screen. Next, go left two 
screens. And then, head south one screen. Here, prepare your character for 
another boss. If you’re ready, go left one screen and fight...

BOSS: METAL CRAB
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         107
GP:                 101
Attacks:            None
Preferred Weapon:   Wind Spear

This will be very easy. Just stay in the middle and always walk to the 
opposite of where the Metal Crab is going. This way, when he moves up or down, 
you won’t get hurt. To damage it, you must hit its mouth so the Wind Spear is 
the ideal weapon for this.

Note: Watch out every time the Metal Crab is in the center. It may or may not

move down or up. 
#############################################################################

After beating the Metal Crab, a ladder will appear on the lower left. So, use 
that ladder. In this new area, head left three screens and use the ladder at 
the end. You’ll find yourself in the World Map again. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Here, go left one screen and then to the south one screen. Next, go right one 
screen. Now, go south four screens. Here, you’ll see an enemy that looks like 
a robot. If you accidentally touched it, it may inflict the Moogle condition 
at you. During this time, your defense will drop to 0 and you will receive a 
very large amount of damage from enemies. Now, from here, go right one screen. 
Use the Recovery Spring at your leisure. After that, head back to the left one 
screen. Then, go north one screen (note: use the upper right path. The Upper 
left ones will bring you back where you came from). Next, go right one screen. 
Now, go up one screen and then go right one screen. In here, you’ll see 2 
ladders going up. 

Go up the right ladder first. Move on until you see the Weapon Shop. If you 
have the money, go and buy the Opal Equipments. They are very strong in 
defense compared to the Gold ones. If you don’t have enough money, just beat 
the enemies around you until you are able to buy the equipments. After buying 
the equipments, leave the shop and go all the way down and use the other 
ladder to the left. 

Now, go all the way up and when you can’t go any further, go left one screen. 
Here, equip your axe. Now here’s the diagram again for the trees you must cut 
in order to move on.

     x  2
    ttttt     Legend:

    x         2 – Your Destination

blocks your way and go north two screens. Next, head right one screen. Then,

=========
MT. ROCKS
=========
Weapon:
  Morning Star!
Magic:
  Lit (Lightning)

This level isn’t confusing at all, if you know what to do :) Now, from your 
starting point, go up one screen and then go right two screens. If you 
returned to the left, you’ll be back at the starting point so follow my 
instructions carefully. Now, at the end, Equip your mattock and break the 
north wall then go up one screen. Next, go left one screen. In here, you have 
to put all 4 treasure chests on the 4 tiles on the ground. If you accidentally 
destroyed a chest, leave the room and come back again. After placing the 4 
chests the door to the north won’t open right? To open the door, just attack 
one of the 4 chests and the door will open (I don’t know why it should be this 
way). After opening the door, go north one screen. Now, go right one screen. 
Here, use a key, open the door to the right and then continue moving right 
until you can’t go right anymore. Here, go south three screens.

Next, go right two screens. Here, use the ladder at the end. Now, prepare your 
character for another boss. If you’re ready, go right one screen and then 
fight!

BOSS: CYCLOPS   
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         70
GP:                 64
Attacks:            Morning Star Lounging Attacks
Preferred Weapon:   Chain

Basically, he is very easy. Just stay above or below him and keep on attacking 
him. Just make sure that you are out of the way of his attacks. He will only 
attack horizontally which will be very predictable. Sometimes though, he will 
attack twice in a row. But, there are no other problems that you should worry 
about.  
#############################################################################

After beating the Cyclops, you’ll see a chest appear in the middle. It’s the 
dreaded Morning Star! Now you can kill most of the enemies with this weapon! 
You can also dump or sell your Mattocks as the Morning Star can destroy walls. 
You can also destroy rocks that block your way. After getting it, equip it 
right away. Now, go to the left one screen and use the ladder. And then, go 
all the way to the left until you reach the starting point in the game (The 
ladder and the 3 rocks).  Don’t worry, trust me, just keep on going LEFT. When 
you reach the entrance, go north one screen. Here, use the key to open the 
north door. Now, prepare your character again for another boss. Equip your 
Morning Star. If you’re ready go north one screen and meet...

BOSS: GOLEM     
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         98
GP:                 173
Attacks:            Charging Attack from different directions
Preferred Weapon:   Morning Star Only!

This boss is an average enemy. YOU MUST USE THE MORNING STAR in this battle. 
It has only one kind of attack in which it charges its body vertically. It 
will be walking on the top portion of the room and may or may not charge when 
it reaches the left corner, the middle, or the right corner. It can attack 
diagonally also. Basically, you can’t predict where it will attack but if you 
get damaged heal quickly as its charge attacks deal quite a big amount of 
damage.
#############################################################################

After beating Golem, you will receive the Magic book of Lightning (lit). Now, 
go north one screen and use the ladders here. You’ll now find yourself 
outside. In here, go to the bridge and go right one screen. When you enter the 
cave, you’ll see the bridge collapse. You can’t go back anymore. Then, the 
screen fades. Now, you’ll be on a very familiar place. The waterfall at Castle 
Glaive!

=============
GLAIVE CASTLE
=============

From the waterfall, go right two screens. The castle gate is now open so go 
inside. Inside, go left one screen. Equip your Axe and hack the trees to the 
left. And then, go left one screen. Next, go up one screen and enter the door 
at the end. You’ll now find yourself inside the Castle itself.

Inside, Cross the 2 bridges and then go north one screen. Next, cross the 
bridge and go right one screen. In here, cross the bridge and go right one 
screen. Next, cross the left bridge and then go right one screen. In this 
screen, just cross the bridge again and use the ladder in the corner.

In this new area, just climb all the way up the vines and use the ladder at 
the end. In the next screen, use the ladder that you’ll see on the right 
corner. Now, go down the ladder. Prepare your character again for another 
boss. If you’re ready, go left and meet...

BOSS: CHIMERA
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         20
GP:                 91
Attacks:            Zigzag Charging attack, fireballs
Preferred Weapon:   Morning Star

Beware! Chimera might give you some troubles. It usually stays on top firing 
fireballs at you. Sometimes (most frequently), it will charge at you in a 
zigzag pattern. During this time, you can either dodge it if your fast enough, 
so just stay on the corner and hope that it won’t hit you. The damage is quite 
big so prepare to heal Sumo anytime.
#############################################################################

After beating Chimera, use the ladders to the left. You’ll now see Fuji inside 
a room. She will tell you that you must get the pendant right away and that 
Dark Lord’s room is on the top floor. After talking, use the lower right 
ladder. In the next room, use the upper right ladders. You’ll be in a familiar 
area (to the left of the vines you climbed up earlier).

Now, you can go 3 ways here. Either go directly to the south, go south using 
the ladder, or go left. Let’s call it POINT A. Now, use the ladder first to 
the next screen to the south. And then, go left one screen and go inside the 
small house. You’ll see someone who sells items. Now is the perfect time to 
sell ALL your Mattocks and buy a lot of Keys. 8 Sets is what I recommend. 
After buying items, you can rest on any bed to regain all your HP and MP. 
After preparing, go back to POINT A. From POINT A, go left three screens. And 
then, go south one screen and enter the door at the end. 

In this new area, you have to walk over the Spikes in order to move on. After 
doing so, have Fuji heal you by asking her. After healing, go up one screen 
and then go right one screen. Here, destroy the north wall and then go up one 
screen. Next, go left one screen. Here, equip your Chain. Now, use the chain 
first on the northern most pole. Now wait until your Will Bar fills up, then 
use the chain on the left pole. Now, step on the switch. A ladder will appear 
on the lower right corner of the room. Now, wait again until your Will Bar 
fills up and then use it on the southern most pole. Now, use the ladder.

In this new area, go north one screen and then go right one screen. Next, go 
south two screens. In here go right one screen first. Now, use a Key on the 
right door and enter it. You’ll see a bed here where you can rest and restore 
your HP and MP. After resting, from here, go all the way to the left until you 
see a room filled with Werewolves, 4 chests and a ladder. All you have to do 
here is to prevent hitting the 4 chests. If you accidentally hit a chest, the 
ladder will disappear, so you have to leave the room and come back again. 
Let’s continue. Now, go and use that ladder. In the next room, to right two 
screen. Now, use your Morning Star to break the right wall. After that, go 
right two screens and north one screen. In here, use the ladder at the corner. 
Now, go south one screen. Here, go one screen to the right. In this room, 
you’ll have to fight the Knights. After beating all the Knights in this room, 
get the chest for the Blood Sword. Now, go back left one screen and then north 
one screen. Here, instead of using the ladders, break the north wall and then 
go north one screen and then go right one screen and use the ladder. 

In this new area, go south one screen. And then go left one screen. In this 
room, there are 2 floor switches. You have to use your Ice Magic to turn the 
knights into Snowmen. Note that the Black Mages here cannot be turned to 
snowmen. If there’s only one knight, leave the room and then come back again 
until you see 2 knights. Now, turn them into Snowmen and put them on the 2 
switches. After you’ve put the 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear 
on the lower right corner. Now, use that ladder. Here, go left one screen and 
then go up one screen and use the ladder in the middle. Next, go north one 
screen. You’ll now notice that this is a throne room. In fact, it is Dark 
Lord’s Room. Now, I suggest you do a simple level up trick.

section: big so prepare to heal Sumo anytime.
text:
The Dark Mages and the Knights give off a fair amount of EXP. So, beat all of 
them inside the throne room and then save. And then, reset your Gameboy by 
pressing A,B,Start and Select buttons AT THE SAME TIME. Now, load your game 
again. Do this pattern until you level up or up to how many times you want. If 
you feel you’re ready, from the throne room, go left one screen. Now, prepare 
your character and then SAVE the game. You’ll now face Dark Lord!

BOSS: DARK LORD 
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         166
GP:                 11
Attacks:            Sword Attacks
Preferred Weapon:   Morning Star

He isn’t as hard as you think. All you have to do is to use your Morning Star. 
It will pass through his shield and damage him. The one thing that you must be 
aware of is that he has a good AI and can follow you even if you try to run 
away from him. You don’t have to worry about his sword attacks. All you have 
to do is to stay away from him to prevent him from damaging you when he

touches you.
#############################################################################

After beating Dark Lord, you’ll receive the pendant. But, you’ll notice that 
it is fake! So, use the ladder on the lower right corner. In the next room, 
you’ll see that Fuji is not here anymore. So, Julius might have done something 
to her. After that, you’ll be taken automatically outside the castle. Here, 
you’ll see Fuji. You’ll try to call her but she will ignore you. After you’ve 
regained control of your character, go all the way to the left to the 
waterfalls. 

Here, you’ll see that Julius already mesmerized Fuji. Julius will tell you 
that he is the only one left from Vandole and he must one again acquire the 
power of Mana. Fuji will now reverse the waterfall. In you last desperate 
moment to save Fuji, Julius will blast you again and you’ll fall again. 

After your fall, you’ll find yourself in the world map, but you cannot move. 
Then, the Chocobo will come and pick you up and brings you inside the town of 
Ish.

===
ISH
===

When you wake up, you’ll find yourself in the house of Sarah together with, 
guess who, Bogard! You’ll immediately stand up and begin hesitating about 
what’s happening to you, about being a Gemma knight and about Mana. Then, 
Bogard will tell you to shut up and you’ll get out of the house. Now, talk to 
Sarah. She will tell you that she believes in you that you are the only hope 
in saving the world. Then, she’ll tell you that chocobo is being treated at 
Doctor Bowow’s house. Let’s head there first before going to the shops. From 
Sarah’s house, go left two screens. Now, enter the house. Right before 
entering, you’ll hear some weird sounds coming from the house. Inside, you’ll 
see Dr. Bowow and Chocobo. Dr. Bowow will tell you that he mechanized the 
Chocobo’s wounded leg and can travel by water! He named it the Chocobot! Then, 
Dr. Bowow will tell you also that you are the only hope and that you should 
talk to Bogard first before leaving town. So, head back to Sarah’s house and 
talk to Bogard. Now, Bogard will tell you that from here onwards, your 
adventure will be much more dangerous. You must now endure in the quest for 
the Excalibur to be able to defeat Julius. Just like Bogard and co. once did 
against Vandole. You should now go and talk to Cibba to know more. Dr. Bowow 
knows the direction but let’s ME help you this time. Now, let’s prepare your 
character. Leave Sarah’s house and go to the weapon shop. And then, go buy 
items at the Item Shop. After that, you’ll also notice that your HP and MP are 
still the same just as it was after beating Dark Lord, so head to the Inn and 
pay a small amount (10 G) to rest. After resting, from the in, go all the way 
to the south until you reach the World Map.

=====
WORLD
=====

Once outside, talk to your new chocobot so that he would join you. Now, follow 
my instructions carefully so that you’ll reach Wendel in no time. 

From Ish, Go left one screen and then go north two screens. Next, go left two 
screen. Here, you’ll see a wooden dock. So, ASK the chocobot to give you a 
ride. Now, you can walk on water when you use the dock. Just put your chocobot 
on the docks and simply enter the water. When you’re in the water, go north 
one screen. Next, go right SEVEN screens and then go up one screen. Use the 
docks here and then go north one screen. You’re now exactly at Wendel. Now, 
jump off your Chocobot and enter Wendel.

======
WENDEL
======

upon entrance, go north one screen. Here, you’ll see a lady which looks like a 
mouse. If you talk to her, she will tell you that Lorim was attacked by many 
monsters and Cibba went there! She will also tell you that it is south from 
the snowfields. After hearing that, leave Wendel right away. Get your Chocobot 
(I won’t remind you again next time, so always remember take your chocobot 
after you leave a town or a dungeon.). In the world map, go south one screen 
from Wendel and use the docks again. From the docks, head south two screens. 
And then, go left four screens. Here, go south one screen. From here, just 
move one (the path is pretty straight forward) until you see another dock. Use 
than and then go up the ladder up to the next screen. In this screen, a path 
to the left is blocked by trees so go right one screen. And then, go south two 
screens. Next, go right one screen and then go up the big set of ladders and 
enter Lorim.

=====
LORIM
=====

Upon entering the town of Lorim, you’ll notice that the person here is frozen! 
It seems someone or something froze the whole place! From the main room, go up 
one screen. Here, you’ll see the King. Amazingly, he’s not frozen so talk to 
him. He’ll tell you that Julius summoned a monster named Kary and froze the 
Town! Now, it’s time to beat that Kary up! So, leave Lorim at once. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Now, go back to where you saw a path blocked by trees. Now, use your axe and 
hack all the trees here. After hacking all the trees, go north three screens. 
This place is very cold and Chocobot cannot join you from here. So, you have 
to move on without chocobot. Now, go north one screen. And then, go left one 
screen. You’ll see a house here. Enter it. It’s an Item shop so buy all your 
item needs here. After buying, if necessary, leave the shop. 

From the shop, go right three screens. Next, go south one screen and then go 
left one screen and then go south one screen. And then, go right two screens. 
Here, you’ll see the entrance to the Cave of snowfields where Kary is. Enter 
it.

==================
CAVE OF SNOWFIELDS
==================
Item:
  Elixir

Upon entering, go north two screens (use the left sliding floors on the second 
room). On the north room, you’ll see a lot of sliding floors and a snowman. 
Now, step on the upper right switch. A sliding floor will appear beneath the 
snowman. The snowman will now travel through the sliding floors until in 
reaches the end. Now, push it north onto the floor switch. The door on the 
right should now be open. So, go right one screen. Now, use your Flame Flail 
and swing across. Now, go to the sliding floor to the north of this room. In 
the next screen, use your MAXed flame flail on the pole to the left and then 
step on the sliding floor on the left. When you reach the next room, you’ll 
see that you can go next screen to all 4 different directions. Sliding floors 
at the sides, south door and a north door. Go through the north door to the 
next screen (don’t forget to use a key). Now, go right one screen. In here, 
sliding floors block your way. You pass through only at the sliding floor 
which is second from the bottom of the screen. Now, go north one screen. Here, 
use your Morning Star to break the northern wall. And then, go north two 
screens. In here, there are sliding floors again. Just walk to any one of the 
top horizontal sliding floors and it will bring you to the correct one. Once 
your outside of the sliding floors, go right two screens. Here, use the 
ladder. 

In the next area, you’ll see sliding floors going to the right screen and to 
the south screen. Use the right sliding floors. From here, just wait until 
Sumo stops in a screen with Pumpkin and two flowers to the north. Now, use 
your Morning Star and break the north wall. And then, go north one screen and 
use the ladder in there. 

In the next area, break the north wall. Go through it and you’ll see a 
recovery spring. After using it, go south one screen. Here, go left one screen 
and then go south one screen. Kill all the enemies in this room. A chest will 
appear in the center. Now, get it for an elixir. And then, go back north one 
screen and then go right two screens. Here, go north one screen. Next, just 
walk on the sliding floors then use the ladder at the upper right. In this 
area, just go right one screen and enter the door. Next, use your MAXed flail 
to reach the pole. After crossing over the sliding floors, go left two 
screens. Next, go south one screen. In this room, walk to the sliding floor 
and use your flail on the poles in the middle. After that, step in the switch. 
A portion of the sliding floors will disappear. You can now step on the lower 
right floor switch. The door will now open. Now, go south one screen. Here, 
just go through the sliding floor and then go right two screens. In this room, 
you can either go right or south. Go right one screen by using the sliding 
floor. On the next screen, use the south sliding floor. When you reach the 
next screen, you’ll see a small pond in the middle then, use the sliding floor 
to the south. On the next screen, use your flail to reach the pole to the 
left. Take note that you do not the a MAXed flail here. Now, go left using the 
sliding floors. Now, you should be in a room where you can see a pit in the 
middle and a wooden bridge over it. You’ll also see the sliding floors to the 
left and right. Now, equip your flail (if it isn’t equipped) and use the left 
sliding floor. When you reach the next room, try to hit the 2 poles on the 
left wall. If you’re not successful, you’ll be back at the room with the pit. 
Just continue on trying until you are able to hit either of the poles. If 
you’re successful, use your Morning Star on the wall and go left one screen. 
In this room, use your MAXed flail on the leftmost pole. And then use it on 
the northmost one. Now, use the ladder at the corner. And then, go right one 
screen and enter another door. When you reach the room with 3 poles, use your 
flail on the middle pole first and then use it on the lower right one. Now, go 
right one screen. And then go north one screen. Use the ladder in the corner 
again. Now, prepare Sumo for another boss. I suggest that you use the Flame 
Flail for the next battle. If you’re ready, go right one screen and meet Kary.

BOSS: KARY
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         183
GP:                 129
Attacks:            Icicle, Charging Tail attack
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail

Kary is very easy. Just stay on top or below him and continue hitting his 
body. You cannot hit his tail or his hand as they are impervious to attacks. 
He’ll just throw icicles at you and most of the time, charge at you and 
attacking you with his tail. If you have the Flame Shield, it can block ALL of 
the Icicles that are thrown at you.
#############################################################################

After beating Kary, a chest will appear in the middle. Now, examine it and 
you’ll receive the Ice Sword. After that, you’ll be taken automatically to the 
world map.

=====
WORLD 
=====

Now, let’s head back to Lorim. If you don’t remember how to get there, I’ll 
show you how:

From the Cave of Snowfield, go left two screens. Next, go up one screen and 
then go right one screen. Next, go up two screens. From here, go left two 
screens. Now, go south two screens. Get your Chocobot. From here, go south two 
screens. Equip your Axe and hack away the trees then go right one screen. From 
here, it’s pretty straight forward so, go to Lorim now.

=====
LORIM
=====
Item:
  Bone Key

Now, from the main room, to right one screen. And then, go north one screen. 
Cibba will be here. Make sure you have a slot which is free in your Items 
Inventory. If there is, talk to Cibba. You’ll receive the Bone Key right away. 
Then, Cibba will tell you to go through Ammonite Coast then to Floatrocks and 
use the bone Key in the Cave in Floatrocks. He will also tell you that he will 
wait for your return with the Legendary Sword which is with the Guardian of 
the cave. After talking to Cibba, leave Lorim.

=====
WORLD
=====

Let go to Floatrocks! Follow my instructions carefully so you won’t get lost. 
First I suggest you ride your Chocobot. From Lorim, go south one screen and 
then go left one screen. And then, go north two screens then left one screen. 
Now, go south one screen. Here, use the docks and go in the water. 

When you’re in the water go north four screens and then go left one screen. 
And finally, go north one screen. You should now be on top of the map. Now, go 
RIGHT four screens. Don’t go up as you’ll just end up below the map. Let’s 
continue, go south two screens and then go right one screen. Next, go south 
one screen and then right one screen. And then, go south four screens. You 
should now see a water channel to your left. Go left one screen through the 
water channel (river). Now, just keep on moving until you reach another dock. 
Go out of the water and in to dry land.

Now, in dry land, go north one screen and then go right one screen. Here, go 
north first. There’s a recovery spring here. After using it, if necessary head 
south one screen. Then, go south one screen (don’t grab the pole on the left 
side). Then, go right one screen. You’ll be at the shore of Ammonite Coast. 
From here, just go all the way to the north, grabbing the poles if necessary, 
until you reach the weapon shop at the end. You can buy Ice equipments here. 
After buying the equipments, head all the way back to the recovery spring and 
heal yourself. Now, from where the Recovery spring is, just go south one 
screen. Now, chain yourself to the pole on the other side of the waterway.

Now, go south two screens. And then, go right one screen. Here, at the shore, 
go south three screens. And then, go left one screen. Now, you should see some 
Floating Rocks so, equip your Morning Star as it can destroy these rocks. Now, 
from your position, go south one screen. And then, go left one screen. You’ll 
see an item shop so buy items if necessary. After that, leave the shop. From 
the item shop, go right one screen. And then, go south one screen. Next, go 
right one screen (you’ll be at another shore) and then go south 2 screen. 
Here, go left one screen.

section: the Icicles that are thrown at you.
text:
Now, go north one screen. Here, cross the wooden bridge and then go south two 
screens. Now, go left one screen. You’ll see a Weapon shop here. I suggest you 
go in and buy the Thunder Spear. You should have enough money by now. It costs 
11250 you know. Now, after buying the spear, leave the shop. From the shop, go 
south one screen and then go right one screen. Here, go south one screen 
again. Next, go right two screen and then go north one screen. You’ll see a 
Magic Shop here. So, go buy if you want some Magic Items. After buying, leave 
the shop. From the magic shop, go left one screen. Finally, you reached the 
cave of Floatrocks! Now, equip the Bone Key and enter the cave.

==================
CAVE OF FLOATROCKS
==================

Once inside, go north one screen. Open the north door and go north one screen. 
Here, destroy the right wall. And then, go right two screen. Now, destroy the 
rocks and step on the upper switch. And then, destroy the rocks below and step 
on the lower switch. Next, go right one screen and then go up two screens. In 
here, destroy the north wall. And then, go north one screen and use the ladder 
at the end. In this new area, prepare your character for a boss battle. After 
preparing, head right one screen and meet...

BOSS: KRAKEN
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         199
GP:                 150+
Attacks:            Tentacles
Preferred Weapon:   Thunder Spear

If your slow, you might have some troubles with Kraken. It has two tentacles 
by it’s side. Most of the time it won’t attack and sometimes it extends its 
tentacles into the bridge and might hit you. The strategy here is to attack 
then retreat. You must hit its head then quickly move out of the way of its 
tentacles. This way, once it attacks, you’ll be out of harms way. This might 
take long but I’m sure you can beat it.
#############################################################################

After beating Kraken, a door will appear. Go inside it. You’ll be outside now. 
Now, you’ll see a door below right? All you have to do is to go around this 
small island and you’ll be able to reach that door. Once you reach it, enter 
it right away.

Inside, you’ll face new and stronger enemies but they sure give you a lot of 
EXP and Gs. Now, go south one screen. Next, go left two screen and then go up 
one screen. Here, destroy the wall to the left. Now, equip your Ice Magic and 
your Sickle and go left one screen. Here, Hack away all the herbs around both 
switches. Now, you can kill the Dark Mages if there are some but leave the 
knights alive. You have to turn 2 of them into snowmen and place them over the 
switches. If there’s only 1 knight, leave the room and then come back again. 
If you successfully placed 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear in 
the lower right corner. Now use the ladder. In the next area, go left one 
screen. Here, go inside the door at the end. In the next area, go left one 
screen. You’ll see a lava pool in this room. If you touch it, you’ll get A LOT 
of damage! But you have to cross it. So, heal your character to the MAX and 
cross the lava and go north one screen QUICKLY. Now, heal your character 
again. Now, go north one more screen. You’ll see 2 doors here. Go left one 
screen first and then go south one screen. Next, go left one screen. There’s a 
lava pool here but luckily, you won’t have to cross it. Now, go south one 
screen. You’ll see a dreaded Lava Pool. You have to cross it if you want to 
get the treasure. So, cross it quickly and Cure if necessary. Once you reach 
dry land, use a key and go south one screen. Here, kill all of the enemies and 
a chest will appear in the middle. It’s the most powerful Axe in the game. The 
Zeus Axe! Now, go north one screen and cross the lava pool again and go up 
another screen. Here, destroy the right wall again and go right one screen 
(there’s no point in going left). Next, go up one screen and then go right one 
screen. 

In here, go north one screen. Here, break the right wall and go right one 
screen and use the ladder. Outside, just use the other door on top. In the 
next area, go north one screen and then go right two screens. Here, go south 
one screen. If you’re HP/MP are low, go south one screen for a recovery spring 
and then come back one screen. Here, open the right door and go right one 
screen. Here, destroy the lower right rock and use the ladder that appear. In 
the next screen, you must choose among 3 doors. Choose the right most door as 
the other 2 will only confuse you and won’t get you anywhere. Now, in the next 
area, go south one screen and then go left one screen. Here, get your Ice 
Magic ready and head north one screen. Here, turn any 2 monsters into snowmen 
and push them on to the floor switches. After placing 2 snowmen on the 
switches, a ladder will appear. Just attack the snowmem and you can now use 
the ladder that appeared. In the next area, prepare your character once more. 
Now, equip him with the Thunder Spear and Cure Magic and heal his HP/MP. If 
you’re ready go left one screen and meet...

BOSS: IFLYTE
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         223
GP:                 264
Attacks:            Rolling Attack
Preferred Weapon:   Thunder Spear

Iflyte is very easy. Just attack him using the Spear. When he does his rolling 
attack, just dodge it. You won’t have any problems at all. He’ll also stay for 
a while on the top or at the bottom of the screen.
#############################################################################

After beating Iflyte, a chest will appear in the middle. Examine it to get the 
Rusty Sword. Then, you’ll be taken automatically outside. 

=====
WORLD
=====

There’s a glitch here. If you arrive in the world map and the chocobot is in 
the upper left corner, you can’t talk to it because the rocks get in the way. 
All you have to do is to leave this screen and come back again and talk to the 
chocobot and take it with you again. Now, we’ll have to go all the way back to 
Lorim and see Cibba once more. I’ll tell you again how to get there if you 
forgot. Here it is:

From the cave, go right one screen and then go south one screen. From here, go 
left two screens. Next, go north one screen and then left and then north 
again. You’ll be at the shop where you bought the Thunder Spear. From here, go 
right one screen and then go north two screens. Cross the wooden bridge then 
go south one screen and then one screen to the right. You’ll be back at the 
shore. Here, go north two screens then go left one screen and then go north 
two screens more. Here, go right one screen. You’ll now be at the Ammonite 
Coast Area.

Next, go north three screens and then go left one screen. Here, go north one 
screen. Now, use your Flail and cross the river. And then, go north one 
screen. Here, you can go north and recover at the Springs. After using the 
Springs, go south one screen then go left one screen. Now, go south one 
screen. Now, go into the water using the docks. 

In the water, go north one screen. And then, go right one screen then go south 
two screens and then go right one screen again. You’ll be at the ocean again. 
Here, go north six screen and then go left two screens. Next, go north one 
screen. And then, go left four screens. Now, go down through the water channel 
going to the south and head for Lorim. 

=====
LORIM
=====

When you reach Lorim, talk to Cibba right away. He’ll tell you that the only 
thing left to do is to reveal the Dime Tower in the Desert of Crystal. You 
must then use the Rusty Sword (Legendary Sword) in the Cave of Ruins in order 
to reveal the Tower. The ruins is located in the Desert of Crystal near Ish. 
After a short talk about the Sword, Cibba will tell you to go to Dr. Bowow to 
ask for directions. Nah! You can ask me though! :)

Here’s my instructions to get to the Cave of Ruins:
After talking to Cibba, leave Lorim right away. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Now, in the world map, get your Chocobot. Go to the Ocean and go up until you 
reach the top portion of the map. (You should see the shop in the Snowfields). 
Check you map and check whether your already on top of the map. If you went to 
Bowow, you’ll know that the Cave of Ruins is hidden beneath one of the 
crystals in the Desert of Crystal and you’ll need a very powerful magic to 
destroy the crystal covering the entrance. It is the Nuke Magic. Bowow will 
tell you to beat Lich at the Palmy Desert. I’ll just tell you how to get there 
and beat Lich for the Nuke, the strongest magic in the game.

section: a while on the top or at the bottom of the screen.
text:
From your current location (on top of the map), go left until you see the 
docks in the Desert of Crystal (Ish Area). Here, don’t go to dry land, 
instead, go north three screens. You’ll see the Palmy Desert and the docks. 
Use the docks to enter dry land. Now, from your current position, go left one 
screen. And then go south one screen then go left one screen. Next, go south 
one screen again and then go left one screen again. Here, go north one screen. 
You’ll now see the Cave of the Palmy Desert.

====================
CAVE OF PALMY DESERT
====================
Magic:
  Nuke

Once inside, use the other ladder at the lower right corner of the room. In 
the next room, use the other ladder again at the lower right corner. In the 
next area, go down the ladders. Before going north, make sure your HP and MP 
are FULL as you’ll meet one of the most damaging enemy in the game! I suggest 
that you use the Flame Flail as it has a fast attack and can hit Lich many 
times. And don’t forget to Save. Now, if you’re ready, go north and battle 
Lich.

BOSS: LICH
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         196
GP:                 204
Attacks:            Skulls
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail

You must be very fast as Lich flies around quickly. He’ll also lunge at you 
some nasty skulls that damages you a lot. And most of all, DON’T EVER TOUCH 
HIM! You’ll receive a very large amount of damage! All you have to do is to 
try to evade him at the same time, hitting him with your Flail. Your Flame 
Flail will be fast enough for you to move away from Lich. The only advantage 
Lich can give you is that, you can hit Lich on any part of his body. So, try 
to be patient.

Note: You can hit the Skulls with your weapons. 
#############################################################################

After the battle, you’ll now receive the Nuke Magic. Then, you’ll 
automatically be taken on the world map. 

=====
WORLD
=====

Now, if you return to Dr. Bowow, he’ll now tell you the location of the 
crystal that covers the Cave of ruins. I’ll just tell you how to get there to 
save time. Now, from the Cave, go back to the docks and into the water. From 
here, go south three screens and you’ll arrive in the Docks at the Desert of 
Crystal. Go to Dry Land and then go right one screen. Here, you’ll see 2 
crystals in the middle. Use your Nuke and blast the one on the right. A cave 
opening should now appear. Enter it and you’ll be in the Cave of Ruins.

=============
CAVE OF RUINS
=============
Equipments:
  Dragon Sword
  Dragon Shield

Upon entering, go left two screens. Next, go north one screen. In here, use 
the slippery floors and go right one screen. You can now get the 2nd best 
shield in the game, the Dragon Shield. After getting the shield, go left one 
screen again. This time, go north two screen. In here, go left two screens. 
Now, you’ll get the Dragon Sword. After getting the sword, go right two 
screens. Next, go right two screens. And then, go north three screens. Next, 
go left one screen, Now, prepare your character for another boss battle. If 
you’re ready, go north and face...

BOSS: MANTIS ANT
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         214
GP:                 229
Attacks:            Charging Attack
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail

You’ll have to cross the lightning barrier so that you’ll be in the middle. 
When you’re inside, cure at once and then hack away with your Flame Flail. 
Most of the time, Mantis Ant will stay on top. He rarely uses his charging

section: attack but it is very easy to evade. Trust me, Mantis Ant is easy.
text:
attack but it is very easy to evade. Trust me, Mantis Ant is easy. 
#############################################################################

After the battle, heal your HP to the MAX. After that, equip the Rusty Sword 
and go right one screen. In here, step on the Floor Switch while you have the 
Rusty Sword Equipped. It will release it’s power now. Then, you’ll be 
automatically taken to the world map. A message will show up. Dime Tower 
should now appear somewhere in this desert.

=====
WORLD
=====

This will now be your last time to see the World Map. You can buy Equipments 
and Items (especially Keys). So, go visit Ish one last time. Once there, sleep 
at the Inn and buy Keys until you have 8 sets of it in your inventory. If 
you’re ready, let’s head for the Dime Tower. I repeat, there’s no turning back 
now.

From Ish, go left one screen and then south one screen and finally to the left 
one screen. You’ll see the Dime Tower emerge from the ground. Now, this will 
be the last time that you’ll see the world map so come here prepared. Take 
note that if you go left one screen and the north one screen, you’ll see a 
Magic Shop. Buy something if you need it. If you’re ready, go to the Dime 
Tower and enter the door. (Bye Chocobot!)

==========
DIME TOWER
==========
Equipment:
  Dragon Armor

upon entering, you’ll see Marcie. A robot created by Dr. Bowow 50 years ago. 
She’ll be able to help you by restoring your MPs! Wow! Unlimited Magic! Let’s 
move on.

From the first room, go left one screen and then go north two screens. Now go 
north and go tot he tablet. It says “THE TREE OF MANA GROWS WITH THE ENERGY OF 
NATURE”. After seeing it, go back south one screen. You can bypass these 
tablets but they have infos about Mana. Now, go right one screen. Next, go 
south one screen and then go right one screen. You’ll see another tablet. It 
says “THE EVIL FORCE OR PEOPLE MAKES THE TREE EVIL”. After that, go right one 
screen. Next, go north one screen. From here, you can choose any of the 2 
paths. 

Path #1
-------
From the screen with 4 floor switches in the middle, go left one screen. Next, 
go up one screen and then go left one screen. Use the ladders here. In the 
next area, go left one screen and then go south one screen. Next, go right one 
screen. Now, go south two screens. You’ll see another tablet that says “ONE 
WHO TOUCHES THE MANA TREE GETS THE POWER”. From here, go right one screen. Go 
to meeting point...

Path #2
-------
In the screen with 4 floor switches in the middle, use your Flail to go in the 
middle. Just step on all floor switches and the door to the north will open. 
After that, go north one screen and use the ladders. In the next area, go up 
one screen using the vines. In this screen, just enter the door. Now, go south 
three screens and then go left one screen.

Meeting Point
-------------
Now, use the ladders. In the next area, go up one screen using the vines to 
the left. On the next screen, enter the door. Now, go left one screen. There 
are 2 locked doors here, one to the left and one to the north. Let’s call this 
Point AA. Now, equip a key then go north one screen. Next, go right one 
screen. You can now get the Dragon Armor from the chest in the middle. If you 
go north one screen and move on, you’ll reach a tablet that says, “GEMMA 
KNIGHT WITH THE RUSTY SWORD WILL BE TESTED. THE TRUE GEMMA KNIGHT SHOULD BE 
GIVEN THE LEGENDARY SWORD, EXCALIBUR...!”. Now, go back to Point AA. If you go 
left one screen, you’ll see another tablet that says “KING OF VANDOLE GOT THE 
MIGHTY POWER OF MANA. THE ONLY ONE WHO CAN STAND AGAINST IT IS THE... GEMMA 
KNIGHT... WITH THE... EXCALIBUR...”. Let’s go to Point AA again. From here, go 
north one screen again. Here, destroy the left wall and go through it to the 
next screen. Then, use the ladders. In the next screen, just use the other 
ladder. In the next area, equip your axe and hack the 2 trees that are 
covering the 2 monsters. Be careful not to hit them. If you accidentally 
killed one of them, just save and then restart the game again. Now, once the 
trees are gone, use your Ice and turn them into snowmen. The north door will 
now open. Then, go north one screen and then go right one screen.

You’ll see another tablet that says “THE VANDOLE SOON SHOULD FALL. WE LEAVE 
OUR LAST HOPE IN THE CAVE OF THE WATERFALLS. GLORY TO VANDOLE AND TO OUR CHILD 
OF HOPE...!”. Now, go south one screen and use the ladder there. In the next 
screen, prepare your character for a boss fight. If you’re already prepared, 
go north one screen and face...

BOSS: GARUDA
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         221
GP:                 266
Attacks:            Feather Blades, Charge
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail

I suggest you use the Flame Flail as it can attack more times than the other 
weapon types. Garuda is VERY EASY! Just stay on the lower left corner if he is 
on the upper left, and go to the lower right corner if he is on the upper 
right. Just attack and attack while you’re in the corner. Once he charges, 
just follow him. You’ll receive no damage at all. Your Flail will destroy all 
Feather Blades that he throws at you. 
#############################################################################

After the battle, the tower will crumble. It lost its balance. One you regain 
control of your character, go left one screen. In the next screen, you can 
take advantage of Marcie for the last time. Equip your Cure magic and then use 
it until your HP is at full. Then, ASK Marcie to restore all MPs! After doing 
this trick, go left one screen. 

Now, a piece of the tower will fall. You can’t go to the other side. Marcie 
will then kick you so that you can reach the other side. Once you reach the 
other side, you’ll see a sad scene. Marcie is unable to jump. The Dime Tower 
will come crashing down including Marcie. Sumo will have a surge of emotion 
afterwards (he’ll shout).

=============
GLAIVE CASTLE
=============

When you regain control of Sumo, keep moving left. You’ll notice that you’re 
at Glaive Castle. You don’t have to enter the castle itself. Go all the way to 
the left towards the waterfalls. Once you reach it, it’s current will now go 
up and Sumo will go for it. You’ll be taken WAY WAY up until you reach the 
top. You’re now at the Final Dungeon in the game, the Temple of Mana.

==============
TEMPLE OF MANA
==============

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
SUPER TIP #1:
You can get Elixirs from the Ninja’s right? Now, if your item inventory is 
full and you examine a chest left by a ninja, it will say “Can’t Carry” right? 
Now, here's something great. Keep on examining it and you’ll get the most 
powerful Armor in the game, the Samurai Armor.

SUPER TIP #2:
The Devil Heads here that can only be destroyed by using the Nuke Magic, give 
off X-Ethers. If you do the same thing as you did to the Ninja, you’ll be able 
to get the most powerful Helmet in the game, the Samurai Helmet.

SUPER TIP #3:
The Elephants near the last boss will give you a Unicorn. If you do the same 
thing as you did with the Ninjas and the Devil Heads, you’ll get the most 
powerful shield in the game, the Aegis Shield. It can deflect ANY projectile 
attack at you. Even the strong force balls of the last boss.
\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\

Now, move on until you enter the Temple itself. Inside, just go south one 
screen and then go right two screens. Next, go north two screens. In here, 
equip a key and go north one screen and then use the ladders. In the next 
area, prepare your character for a boss fight. After the preparations, go 
north one screen and face...

BOSS: DRAGON
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         0
GP:                 257
Attacks:            Fire Ball
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail or Thunder Spear

This is a very easy fight. Just use your Flail or Spear to attack the Head 
ONLY. You can’t damage any other part of its body. 
#############################################################################

After the fight, use the teleporter that appears. In the next screen, just go 
right one screen (You’ll see the Devil Heads here so use Super Tip #2) and use 
the teleporter. 

In the next screen, go left one screen. Here, go north one screen and then go 
left two screens and use the teleporter at the end. In the next area, just go 
right to the next screen and use the teleporter. In the next area, go south 
one screen. Here, destroy the left wall then go left two screens. Next, go 
south one screen. Here, go left one screen and use the teleporter. Next, go 
left one screen and then go south one screen. Now, in this room, there’s a 
trapped monster in the bottom of the screen. Now, equip your Ice Magic and use 
to turn the monster into a snowman. Your Ice can pass through the circle 
thingy (whatever) so you can reach it. It’s easy to guide your icicle, just 
try again if you fail. If you successfully turned the monster into a snowman, 
the right door will open. Now, go right one screen and use the ladder. In the 
next screen, prepare your character again for another boss. If you’re prepared 
go north one screen.

BOSS: RED DRAGON
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         0
GP:                 257
Attacks:            Fire Ball
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail or Thunder Spear

It’s just the same as the previous dragon. Just use your Flail or Spear to 
attack the Head ONLY. You also can’t damage any other part of its body. 
#############################################################################

After you beat the Red Dragon, use the teleporter that will appear. In the 
next area, just go left one screen and use the teleporter. Now, go right one 
screen and then go north one screen and use the teleporter. In the next area, 
go right one screen and use the teleporter. 

Now, go south one screen and then go right one screen. Now, let’s call this 
screen Point BB. From here, go right one screen and use the teleporter. In the 
next screen, go left one screen using a key. Use the Recovery Spring and then 
go back to Point BB. From here, go south one screen and use the teleporter. 
Now, go left one screen and use the teleporter. When you reach the next area, 
go right five screens. Here, you’ll see a lot of floor switches formed in a 
rectangle. You have to change a Ninja into a snowman and put it in the correct 
Floor Switch. In the left COLUMN of switches, the correct one is the ones 
which is second from below. Put the snowman there and the door to the north 
will open. Now, go north three screens and use the ladder. In the next screen, 
just like a while ago, prepare your character again. If you’re ready, go north 
one screen.

BOSS: DRAGON ZOMBIE
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         0
GP:                 270
Attacks:            Fire Ball, Charge Attack
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail or Thunder Spear

The Dragon Zombie looks like the two-headed dragon you fought way back at the 
Cave of Marsh. All you have to do is to attack the head with your flail or 
spear. Beware though, if his fireballs hit you or you accidentally touched it, 
it will deal a big amount of damage compared to the previous 2 dragons.
#############################################################################

After the battle, use the teleporter that will appear. From here on, the path 
is pretty straight forward to the final boss! You can now use my Super Tip #3 
to get the Aegis shield for the best protection. Now, on the way, you’ll see 
Fuji’s Mom. She’ll tell you that you have been a great Gemma knight. She will 
now bestow you with the most powerful weapon in the game, the Excalibur! Equip 
it right away then move on. NOW READ CAREFULLY. When you reach the area where 
you can see 2 big trees to the left and right and a big ladder in the middle, 
prepare your character for the final battle! I recommend level 50+ when you’re 
here. You can level up your character by beating the elephants here until you 
reach level 50. If you’re ready go up the ladder and fight Julius!

NOTE: YOU WILL RECEIVE EXP AND GP!!! This very odd! The EXP is useful as you 
can level up while you fight Julius. But the GP? It’s useless.

FINAL BOSS: JULIUS (3 Forms)  162438 - 61535
#############################################################################
Note: You should use the Excalibur Sword. But if you want some challenge, try 
using the Broad Sword! :) And, in all three forms of Julius, the charging 
attack of the MAXed sword is the most efficient attack to use.

FIRST FORM:
-----------
Attacks:  Sword
EXP:      638
GP:       818

Julius will be in triplets. You just have to attack and beat all three until 
all of them disappears. After that, prepare for Julius’ second form.

SECOND FORM:
------------
Attacks:  Lightning Bolts, Charging Attack
EXP:      0
GP:       162

He will turn into a monster now and Julius will be harder to avoid this time. 
He’ll be flying on top while throwing Lightning bolts. From time to time, he 
will also charge downwards so try to be always by his side. He can charge from 
left to right or vice versa though.

THIRD FORM:
-----------
Attacks:     Teleportation, Force Ball
EXP and GP:  No more

He will turn into a head with 2 arms. He will teleport from one place to 
another. There is a pattern but I won’t include it in the guide. Also, while 
teleporting from place to place, he will be throwing force balls at you. With 
you Aegis Shield, the force balls are NOTHING! He will be hard to beat, but 
with Fuji as your companion, you can ASK her to regenerate your HP while 
fighting. What I did was I also equipped the Nuke at the same time, attacking 
with the Excalibur. These made short work of him!
#############################################################################

After you beat all 3 forms of Julius, you’ll see a short scene. It’s somewhat 
sad but happy at the same time. I won’t spoil it, just finish the game. :) 
Well, that’s it for the best RPG for the Gameboy (My rechargeable batteries 
got a beating). So, thank you for reading the guide and congratulations! I 
hope you enjoyed the game! Until then. C’ya!

                          =-=-=-=-=--=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
                                GAMEPLAY TIPS
                          -=-=-=-=-==-=-=-=-=-=-=-=

1. The Moogle (Moog) condition cannot be cured even with the Moogle Item. If 
it is inflicted to your character, there are 2 ways to avoid contact with the 
enemy (these will also use up the time so that Moogle will be cured). First, 
ASK your Chocobo for a ride! Your enemies can’t hurt you at all. And then, ASK 
again and your Moog condition will be removed. Second, stay at the edge of the 
current area (in world map/field) or stay in front of the doorways (dungeons, 
towns, etc.) and go back and forth between this area and the other area. This 
will use the time and prevents enemy contact.

2. You are poisoned! (Pois Condition) You don’t want to use Pure or the Heal 
Magic. Stay at the edge of the current area (in world map/field) or stay in 
front of the doorways (dungeons, towns, etc.) and go back and forth between 
this area and the other area. This will use up the time but will definitely 
cure Poison after a while. Doing this also lessens the effect of the poison. 
Your HP will drop at most 2 times only. 

3. Another strategy for Pois. If the Heroine is with you, ASK her. This will 
counter the Pois effect. Every time Pois cuts down your HP, the heroine will 
heal that same amount of HP lost. Therefore, no change of HP will occur when 
in Pois Condition.

4. Yet another Pois Strategy. If you are alone and you don’t have items. 
You’re low on life, surrounded by enemies, and Poisoned at the same time, what 
do you do? Attack like crazy! Hitting the A button rapidly will make your 
character attack continuously. This will slow down the Pois condition. It will 
stop the depletion of your HP. Take note also that this does not mean that the 
Pois condition is cured.

5. In towns, YOU CAN KILL THE PEOPLE! Just be patient though. They have a high 
HP and won’t go down easily. When you use your strongest weapons, about 3-5 
hits will do. If you beat them, they will say their lines afterwards.

6. If you want to get a lot of experience in a certain place but you are 
afraid that the enemies will not respawn anymore? If you have 4 enemies in an 
area, if you beat them all and come back, there will be no more enemies, 
right? But, if you left one of them, alive, and then came back again, the 
enemies will respawn. This is good for leveling up and collecting GPs. 

7. When you strike a wall with a weapon and you hear a cranking sound, use 
your mattock or Morning Star to destroy that wall and reveal a new path. 

8. If an empty chest gets in your way, destroy it with your weapon and it will 
simply, disappear.

9. If there are a lot of rocks, and they are beside each other, you can break 
them in one shot. With the Mattock, stand in between the rocks and then press 
the B button. The 2 rocks will disappear. With the Morning Star, just attack 
the rocks head on. 

10. Once you acquire the Morning Star, you won’t have any need for the 
Mattocks anymore. So, just sell ALL your mattocks to save space in the Items 
Inventory. This will enable you to get more important items such as Keys.

section: 4. What are the most powerful equipments in the game?
text:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. What are the most powerful equipments in the game?

Here they are, the Excalibur (sword), Samurai Armor, Samurai Helmet and the 
Aegis Shield. See Super Tips at the Temple of Mana section in the walkthrough. 
Note: you’ll get the Excalibur automatically.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. What level do you recommend should I be when I battle Julius?

You should be at least Level 50. You won’t have any problems at all when 
you’re at this level.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. Is there a way to cure Moog?

Yes. Ride your Chocobo and then jump off again. You’re Moog status should now 
be removed.

section: 7. Where do you think is the best place to level up?
text:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. Where do you think is the best place to level up?

I leveled up Sumo in 2 places. First, in the snowfield area. I kept running 
back and forth beating all those wolves, walruses, and Snowmen. The second one 
is near Julius. I kept on killing those elephants. Either way you’ll get good 
experience points and GP.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. How much time do I need to finish this game?

In my opinion and in my experience, it will take you about 10-12 hours to 
finish the game with complete equipments and a high level.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. What’s the max level that you can achieve?

Level 99. With 999 HP and 99 MP. The character stats will depend on what you 
chose in previous level ups.

- Aka. Final Fantasy Adventure / Mystic Quest / Adventures of Mana.
- The game doesn't track your play time.
- Physical damage is ATP - DFP. Many enemies have two different ATP
values: one for body contact and one for their actual attack (usually
a projectile). Many enemies are also immune to certain types of damage.
- You have 16 slots for usable items and 12 slots for equipment. The
weapons you can't get rid of will take up 5 slots.
- The PSV-version gives you a few hotkeys.
- The boss fights have been tweaked on the PSV.
- The PSV-version may occasionally crash or have some other issues (eg.
once I ended up inside the wall).
- Both the amount of Exp and Lucre you receive from enemies has a random
variable.
- The max amount of money you can carry is 65 535.
- Status ailments:
 - Doku: 9 hits at 5%.
 - Moumoku: Things get a little dark. Nothing to worry about.
 - Moogle: Unable to act, DFP drops to 0.
 - Kiseki: Unable to move.
- All status ailments last 8 seconds.
- Max HP is 19 + Vit^2 / 10. Max MP pretty much directly increases
with your Int.
- Cure: 20 + Int | 20 + Int*2 (full gauge)
- When you level up, you can choose one of four different ways to build
up your stats. To reach max stats, you need to alternate between Senshi
and Madoushi.

Item: 7x Mattock                                \\\ Topple Region ||
- After your escape, you'll find yourself in Topple outskirts (F7).
- Spend some time leveling up and getting used to the mechanics. When
you level up, your HP and MP is fully restored.
- If you kill all the enemies in a given area, you generally have to
move four areas away to trigger a respawn. However, if you leave at
least one enemy alive, you'll get a respawn/reroll by simply moving
one area away.
- The sword has two different basic attacks: a swing and a thrust. You
trigger the latter by pressing in a direction as you attack.
- The sword also has two different charge attacks. One is a spin attack
where you press Attack while the d-pad is on neutral. Keep holding down
Attack to continue spinning (up to 8 seconds) during which you can move
freely. The other attack is triggered by pressing in a direction when
you attack. This causes you to fly forward and back.
- Pick up the Girl near Topple, then go see Bogard northwest. Use the
Mattocks you find at his place to get through the nearby cave.
- The Girl can heal you if you use the fourth option in the menu (Soudan).

3. - Using Items
==============================================================================

To use Items:

1. Press Start to open the menu, then select ITEM.
2. Place the cursor next to the item you wish to use.
3. Press the A Button to select the item. Press A once more to set the item.
4. Exit all menus and press the B Button when you wish to use said item.

Notes:
-With Keys, just equip it and walk into the door you wish to open.
-Most Special/Story items will be automatically used when the time is right.

To use Equipment:

1. Press Start to open the menu, then select EQUIP.
2. Place the cursor next to the weapon/armor you wish to use.
3. Press the A Button to select the item. Press A once more to equip it.

Notes:
-You can only change Armor/Weapons if you have Armor/Weapons to switch with
 (in other words, you always have to have some kind of Armor/Weapon
  equipped).

Item Labels:

Buff:     <-- Raises stats temporary.
Junk:     <-- Can be sold for money.
Healing:  <-- Restorative items.
Magic:    <-- Disposable magic spells (uses no MP).
Special:  <-- Objects required to push the story along.
Tool:     <-- Utilities, such as Keys.

Location Labels:

Boss:  <-- Obtained from a boss.
Buy:   <-- Purchasable items.
Chest: <-- Items found in treasure chests.
Drop:  <-- Items that monsters drop.
Story: <-- Items obtained as part of the story.

Some items can be obtained in multiple places/ways.

Q: Where did these monster names come from?
A: I tried to use names that were most popular (Read: Ones that a majority of
   other FAQs used) to help with crosschecking. In some instances, I had to
   just make up a descriptive name. Thankfully most monsters are easy enough
   to figure out and are normally locked to areas that would make sense (IE:
   ice monster in Snow Fields).

Q: Hey, more than one monster drops [ITEM NAME HERE].
A: E-Mail it to me, I'll add it and credit you.

Q: Do elemental themed shields and helms not reduce corresponding elemental
   damage?
A: No. Helms increase defense and grant no further bonuses. Shields have no
   stats tied to them and are meant to block certain attacks while also
   providing the hero with the ability to push weaker monsters out of the way.
